This paper first cites the definitions of collaborative learning, then illustrates the application of collaborative learning strategies in College English teaching, and finally demonstrates the significance of collaborative e-learning.)

articleTitle: Study on domestic medical informatics talent cultivation and development countermeasure
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: Medical Informatics is the coalescent of computer science, information technology and medical science, and it is newly-formed leading multi-disciplinary scientific, which is the basic medical development at present and in the future. The personnel who have medical informatics knowledge is essential to China's medical information undertaking, so it is imperative under the Situation to enhance the personnel cultivation of Medical Information. This article is about survey analyses of present situation of medical informatics personnel in China and the development approaches to personnel cultivation.

articleTitle: The preliminary investigation of rural residents' new cooperative medical status
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: Objective: To understand the new cooperative medical status in our country is to provide scientific basis for further improving the new rural cooperative medical policies and promoting rural health service. Method: We investigated the rural residents' new cooperative medical status quo of 520 rural residents in Hubei, Chongqing, Shanxi, Jiangxi etc. by designing the questionnaire of rural cooperative medical status quo by ourselves. Result: The new rural cooperative medical treatment has been launched in most of the rural areas in our country. The farmers most concerned about the cooperative medical accounts and expense account summiting etc. The village clinic is the first choice of institutions after the farmers are ill and most rural residents believe the traditional Chinese medicine treatment. Conclusion: Our government should strengthen the construction of rural basic medical institutions, and perfect the system of new cooperative medical, and improve the professional level of rural medical staffs, at the same time attaching importance to the role of traditional Chinese medicine in the new rural cooperative medical treatment.

articleTitle: Application of multimedia CBS method in medical immunology teaching
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: Based on the characteristic of the course of the medical immunology, there are many advantages with case based study (CBS) and multimedia teaching method. By using case based study (CBS) in medical immunology, the study enthusiasm of laboratory medicine students can be fully aroused. Moreover, multimedia will help students to understand the case easily and help them to expend their thinking and develop the inner potential. Compared to the traditional teaching method, multimedia CBS teaching model not only achieved good results, but also greatly improved the students and teachers qualities.

articleTitle: The teaching reform of the course in Linux to the core of the cultivation of vocational capacity
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: For the demand situation for Linux talent in China at present, through the in-depth study the development status of Linux curriculum system of current university computing, the structure and content of Linux curriculum system to the core of the cultivation of vocational capacity. The course objectives, course design and teaching quality evaluation criteria and so on of the curriculum are around the needs of society and the job, and train occupation ability as the center. In addition, the curriculum system is sums up Systematically. Teaching status and teaching methods of Linux curriculum on universities is researched, combined with the actual situation of our school, the teaching methods for Linux courses are explored and discussed and put forward a viable teaching method, which can improve not only students' vocational capacity but also students' employability and competitivenesss.

articleTitle: The dimensions of Customer Intimacy Relationship and measurement scale development based on customers' perspective
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: This study explores measurement dimensions of the intimacy relationship between shopping website and customer. Based on literature review, theoretical analysis and in-depth interviews, the study define the dimensions of the intimacy relationship between shopping website and customer, and then develop an intimacy relationship measurement scale used to measure the dimensions of the intimacy relationship between shopping website and customer. Finally, the study does an empirical test to examine the scale. This research is based on the customer's perspective, and the finally research results show that the dimensions of the intimacy relationship are website reciprocity, website self-discourse, website empathy, website similarity and website interaction.

articleTitle: Research on decision process based on sequential evolutionary game characterized by learning and psychological factors
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: A novel model which introduces emotion character is proposed to simulate group game process more truly in education training domain. According to different kinds of agents, this model builds individual learning mechanism and Strategy mutation mechanism based on emotion character. Simulation results show that the learning ability promotes individual's even cooperation rate of game and improves group total payoff. And, simulations also show that emotion factor would lead to dramatically fluctuation, whereas has little influences on group even total payoff.

articleTitle: A Fuzzy-Dominance-Driven MOGA and its application in Nutrition Meal Prescription
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: In this paper, we study the fuzzification of the pareto dominance relation and its application in Nutrition Meal Prescription. A generic ranking scheme is presented that assigns dominance degrees to any set of vectors in a scale-independent, nonsymmetric and set-dependent manner. Different fuzzy-based definitions of optimality and dominated solution are introduced. The corresponding extension of the Standard Genetic Algorithm, so-called Fuzzy-Dominance-Driven MOGA (FMOGA), will be presented as well. To verify the usefulness of such an approach, the approach is tested on analytical test cases in order to show its validity. The solutions, provided by the proposed algorithm for the Nutrition Prescription Model,are promising when compared with an existing well-known algorithm.

articleTitle: Exploration and practice of IT operation and maintenance in digital campus
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: Stable, secure, high-speed network is an essential basis for digital campus, so how to effectively improve the level of operation and maintenance, and the level of service is a current and long-term problem for the campus network. Based on the ITIL concepts, it can explore and practice IT operation and maintenance outsourcing of basic network in colleges and universities, so that to initially establish an IT service management model which is process-oriented, customer-centric.

articleTitle: The intervention experiment study of diabetic deaf animal model by Jiangtang Fanglong capsule
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: We discussed the influence of Jiangtang Fanglong capsule (glucose-lowering deaf-preventing capsule) to hearing of experimental diabetic deaf animal model. The experimental diabetic deaf animal model was replicated by disposable intraperitoneal injection of 55mg/kg streptozotocin(STZ) to every Wistar rats. 40 Wistar rats were randomly divided into two groups, treatment group treated by 10g•kg-1•d-1 Jiangtang Fanglong capsule suspension in intragastric gavage, and control group by equivalent normal saline, the two groups were separately accepted auditory brainstem response(ABR) detection in first month,second month,third month after model establishment. After first month, the latency and inter period of each wave of ABR of two groups were no significantly difference(P>0.05);and after second, third month, the latency and inter period of each wave of ABR of treatment group were obviously shorter than that of control group, difference was significant(P<0.05, P<0.01). Our results suggest that Jiangtang Fanglong capsule may be have a prevention and cure function to the hearing of diabetic deaf animal model.

articleTitle: Extraction of plant from complex background in colorful pictures
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: The paper proposes a method for automatically identifying plants by computer based on the analysis that the plants and culture media have different RGB color coordinates and HSI color coordinates scales. The method can identify the plant from the complex culture media background quickly and correctly, and it provides basis for subsequent reconstruction of 3-dimensional structures of plant. The method is designed for processing laboratory soybean images. Experiment suggests that it can quickly identify the characteristics of the soybean and meet the requirements of providing real-time signals for controlling the follow-up variables, so it lays a foundation for further research.

articleTitle: Influences of oxLDL on ABCA1 mRNA expression and cholesterol outflow rate in U937 cells
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: Background To investigate the oxidized low density lipoprotein (oxLDL) on U937 cell ATP-binding cassette transporter A1 (ABCA1) mRNA expression and cholesterol efflux situation. Methods Human U937 cells were incubated with gradient concentrations of oxLDL(0, 25, 50, 75, 100, 125mg/L), and then dyed by oil red O to estimate the content of intracelluar lipid and detect the expressing quantity of ABCA1 mRNA by Real-time Fluorescence quantitative PCR simultaneously. Calculating the cholesterol efflux rates by using the scintillation counter to detect the amount of H3 -cholesterol in each well cell culture plate and medium. Results Real-time Fluorescence quantitative PCR analysis showed that the expression levels of ABCA1 mRNA in monocytes were lower than basal line when not intervened with oxLDL, and increased drastically with oxLDL stimulation, significant difference compared with controls(P<0.01), and reached the highest level at oxLDL 50mg/L, nevertheless, continously increasing the concentration of oxLDL above 50mg/L, the expression decreased. So is the outflowing rate of intracelluar lipid. Oil red O dyeing results also suggested that celluar lipid content was the highest when intervened with 125mg/L oxLDL, and increased most obviously at 50mg/L oxLDL. Cholesterol outflow result also demonstrated that cholesterol outflow rate related with the ABCA1 mRNA expressing quantity. Conclusion With the increase of intervening concentration of oxLDL on U937cells, the exprssion of ABCAl mRNA represented that rising befor 50mg/L oxLDL, and then decreasing, reaching the top point at 50mg/L oxLDL. so was the change in the outflowing rate of intracelluar lipid.

articleTitle: Ontology structure and hyper courseware function of education resources website
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: The thesis is to analyze different organization means of education resources, put forward the application of high-end organization methods such as semantic web, ontology and visualization techniques to build the courseware and even renovate the whole website. The website will be recreated into a hyper-functional courseware, which makes visiting the website resources as effective as studying by courseware. The research is based on the construction of two kinds of ontology.

articleTitle: Construction and analysis of genetic regulatory boolean networks
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: In this paper, a new method to establish jointly the gene regulation network model based on the mutual information theory and the Boolean network will be proposed with examples and a logical rule has been derived as the expression value of one or multiple genes determined by multiple genes accordingly. Based on the logical rule, the gene electric network can be established and analyzed to realize the gene regulation network dynamic transformation, thus analyze the regulation relations among genes. This method can be used in the analysis and study of the biological gene regulatory networks, looking for differences between mutant gene networks changes and the normal gene dynamic changes to try to find the cause of the disease. This paper presents a new point of view that the gene network can be divided into two types as inhibitory and non-suppressed.

Author Keywords: Mutual information of entropy Boolean networks

articleTitle: The application of Information Technology in medical education in China—Using Guangxi Medical University as a case study
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: This article introduces the application of information technology in medical education in China, using Guangxi Medical University as an example. It includes the infrastructure of GXMU's campus network, information technology of school administrative affairs, and various information technology applications in student admissions and employment, education management, classroom teaching, network teaching, laboratory teaching, library services, and logistics' management. Information technology plays an increasingly important role in modern higher medical education.

articleTitle: Chinese ideological and political education in the information age -A preliminary study of the changing roles of university teachers
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: With the information technology modernization and rapid developments in electronic media and the World Wide Web within the last thirty years, every country have to be information technology equipped and competent in every field, especially in education sector. So it is in China. The Ministry of Education (MOE) implemented rigorous plans for both teachers and students to possess the necessary skills and knowledge, especially making the major task for the teachers who mainly bear ideology and political courses. Based on preliminary interviews with practitioners and academics in the area of Education, this paper gives an insight to the changes that have been taking place in the education system in universities of China, especially in what case of university of Xi'an in Shanxi province of China. Overview of the changing roles that ideology education teachers have to assume, a brief discussion on how establish education information management system to make the process of Ideological and political education management and team construction in line with the needs of modern information technology.

Author Keywords: education information management system of CIO

articleTitle: Differential analysis of the BMW compression function
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: In this paper, through constructing a differential path, we analyze the collision process of the compression function Blue Midnight Wish(BMW). BMW is one of the fastest SHA-3 candidates in the second round of the competition. Each word of the compression function Blue Midnight Wish is 32-bit. The differential attack has complexity of about 2<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">32</sup>. The efficient differential path can contribute to find a small number of collision bits.

articleTitle: Evaluation of arteriovenous shunt stenosis in hemodialysis patients by using the burg method for autoregressive modeling
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: This paper proposed the signal processing method for evaluation of arteriovenous shunt (AVS) stenosis in hemodialysis patients. AV shunts are surgically created pathological-physiological fistulas serving as access routes for end-stage renal disease (ESRD) patients. The distinct and periodic bruit of vascular shunts is clearly audible over the access routes. Thus, a bruit spectral analysis could be considered a valuable noninvasive method for quantifying the severity of vessel stenosis. This study collected phonoangiographic data from thirty AV shunts obtained from the electronic stethoscope during the pre- and post-percutaneous transluminal angioplasty (PTA) periods. An autoregressive (AR) model was applied to scientifically analyze the phonoangiographic signals. The AR model and the filter order of eight were chosen to estimate the characteristic frequency of the bruit. The AR model results obtained from the analysis of the phonoangiographic data under the pre-PTA and post-PTA conditions show significant changes in frequency and magnitude. These findings could serve as a noninvasive strategy for early detection of stenotic lesions.

articleTitle: International cultivation of talents for Wood Science and Engineering Specialty based on “ABC-KAQ model”
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: With the global economy developed rapidly, it is particularly urgent and important to speed up development of international cultivation of talents in the agriculture and forestry colleges, to meet the objective demand of talents in new era and enhance the core competitiveness of colleges and universities. This paper pointed out the main problems of Wood Science and Engineering Specialty. Based on the “ABC-KAQ model”, the cultivation system of “practice-innovative” complex talent was put forward, in order to realize win-win goals of the social demand with the agriculture and forestry colleges.

articleTitle: Micro-surgery Education with real-time 3D on a digital display panel
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: We developed world smallest and precise 3D/2D HD surgery visualization, live-casting, collaboration, presentation and education system, named Real Vision 3D. Real Vision 3D®is a 3D visualization system for microsurgery. It offers a “heads-up” way to perform surgery. It also reduces fatigue during operation and helps more precise surgery. Surgeon, resident, assistance, along with a nurse can look at the same surgery content. Real Vision 3D also supports Thunderbolt interface, international broadcasting standards format and High definition video compression format (H.264). It can extend to LED, LCD, Projector, and any display devices.

articleTitle: Survey on similarity measurement of peers in P2P systems
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: In P2P systems, peers are often organized by similarity, trying to ensure the content that any peer needs be found in peers who are in short connections with them to improve the efficiency of searching resources which become popular and difficult in P2P field. First, the background of P2P systems and typical applications are introduced. Then the concept of peer similarity and similarity degree are stated as well as current models. After that, a comprehensive induction on similarity measurement of peers is given, and typical methods were summed up. Finally challenges on similarity measurement are discussed and future research trend of similarity measure on peer sets is also summarized.

articleTitle: Study on scientific and technological olympic games
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: By using the method of documentary and comparative analysis, this paper expatiates on how Olympic movements promote modern technology and modern technology advancement impulse the Olympic movements through analyzing the logic relation between Olympic movements and modern technology, discusses the structure of scientific system of modern Olympic games.

articleTitle: The reformation of teaching methods and curriculum system for software courses
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: This paper first analyzed the problems in the teaching of software courses for computer major, such as not paying enough attention to the practice teaching, with a not perfect teaching system and inappropriately teaching methods. Then we designed a scheme to strengthen the practice teaching and reform software curriculum system, and proposed teaching ideas of “adopting different teaching methods according to the characteristics of different courses to give full play to the students' main role”. Practice has proved that our scheme and teaching ideas are scientific and reasonable, and can improve the teaching quality greatly.

articleTitle: Gibrat's Law review on the theory of firm growth
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: This article In-depth analysis of the evolution of research topics has been made from four aspects which are the type of industry, the size of values, involving geography and findings, to analysis the reason of a variety of conclusions and forecast the future research trends.

articleTitle: An advanced variational level set evolution for image segmentation
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: In this paper, we present an advanced variational formulation based on distance regularized level set evolution(DRLSE)that forces the level set function to be close to a signed distance function, and therefore not only completely eliminates the need of the costly re-initialization procedure, but also allows more efficient numerical scheme than DRLSE and traditional level set methods. Our provided potential function for the regularization term of the internal energy term is improved on the forward and backward diffusion. The advanced distance regularized level set evolution(ADRLSE) avoids the undesirable side effect and the distortedness of the zero level contour and provides more efficient numerical schemes and more smoothed contour. The proposed algorithm has been applied to both simulated and real images with promising results. In particular, it appears to perform more efficient numeration more smoothed contour.

articleTitle: Lifelong learning paradigms for seniors
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: Summary form only given. Recently, Japan has turned to be an aging society where approximately one in five people are elderly, aged 65 or over. This situation results in urgent needs of schemes through which the elderly (seniors) can live vividly and meaningfully, namely live a life with “IKIGAI (motivation in life)”including social participation and self-actuation. I would like to talk about building lifelong learning paradigms through which seniors can find out “IKIGAI” and fully enjoy their active lives. First, we examine what are "IKIGAl" for seniors, mainly focusing on what factors contribute to their QOL (Quality of Life). Social participation is one of key factors for their happy lives. Second, we investigate structures of lifelong learning for seniors from viewpoints of learners' learning purposes or goals which could be grouped into the followings; (a) Group A: Active Paid Worker, (b) Group B: Volunteer, (c) Group C: Educated Person and (d) Group D: Hobbyist. Seniors of Group A and B have desires to directly participate in the society. While seniors of group C pay a keen attention to educational and creative activities, seniors of Group D want to build communities to share common interests. We may conclude lifelong learning paradigms provide good scheme for seniors to find out "IKlGAI", especially in term of social participation. Third, we propose several schemes through which seniors can willingly participate in lifelong learning; 1)Improvement of ICT literacy/competency of seniors. 2) Establishment of course advice centers for seniors. 3) Feedback of seniors' learning results to the society, etc. Finally, it should be pointed out that we need social consensus between the young (juniors) and the elderly (seniors) on further development of lifelong learning paradigms for seniors from economic points of views, for example.

articleTitle: Theoretical analysis of adhering lipid vesicles with free edge based on the bilayer- coupling model
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: A theoretical model for describing the adhesion of lipid vesicle with free edge is developed. For adhesion in contact potential, the total energy functional is defined as the sum of elastic free energy, the surface energy, the line tension energy and the contact potential. The equilibrium differential equation and boundary conditions for adhering opening-up lipid vesicles are derived through minimizing the total energy functional based on the bilayer-coupling model. The relationship of spontaneous curvature model and bilayer coupling model is obtained.

articleTitle: The research on university students' emergency education and ability training based on the information
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: This paper introduces that the important significance of applying information technology to strengthen college students' emergency education and emergency ability training, analyzes that applying information technology to strengthen emergency education and ability training of college students, and distinguishes the advantages of developing the emergency education and cultivating the ability of emergency through informatization. Finally, it proposes several suggestions of enhancing emergency education and emergency ability training of college students through informatization.

articleTitle: Research on the evolution of enterprise clusters based on theory of MAS
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: With the proposition of experimental economics, for solve the problem that the research on the evolution of enterprise clusters has been mainly in theoretical and empirical research for a long time, it makes us study the evolution of enterprise clusters possible through building the mathematical model and the advanced simulation tools. Based on the theory of MAS and the ACE model, a multi-Agent model to simulate the evolution of enterprise clusters has been built and the agglomeration effect and Matthew effect about the enterprise clusters has been researched. At last, it is verified that this model has a high degree of fitting with the evolution process of the enterprise clusters in reality by NetLogo Simulation test.

articleTitle: The analysis of endoscopic-assisted neck minimally invasive thyroid surgery (Experience of 1007 cases)
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: The endoscopic-assisted neck minimally invasive thyroid surgery is one of the main directions of development of thyroid surgery in recent years. The greatest significance of this kind of operation is to solve the patient's disease by a truly minimally invasive and cosmetic way, which is in accordance with modern requirements for high-quality living standards and aesthetic views. We will discuss skills of endoscopic assisted neck minimally invasive thyroid surgery and summarize surgical indicators and relevant experience in this article. Methods To retrospectively analyze clinical data of 1007 cases (727 women and 280 men with a mean age of 34 years) of endoscopic-assisted neck minimally invasive thyroid surgery in The First Hospital of Jilin University in China from June, 2006 to January, 2012. The operation was performed under general anesthesia and tracheal intubation, and we use the Miccoli's technique during the whole surgery. During surgical procedure, we recorded operation time , blood loss, incision size, the postoperative drainage, beauty score, whether the use of analgesics, postoperative time to discharge, hospitalization costs, with or without tumor recurrence , wound infection and other complications . Results 1007 patients were all successfully operated by endoscopic-assisted neck minimally invasive thyroid surgery. The mean operative time of the first 50 cases was (60 ± 13) min; A mean operative time of later 957 cases was (39±9) min. 15-80mL of intra-operative blood loss and 5-5mL of postoperative drainage were confirmed. After two days drainage tubes were removed. Postoperative hospital stay was (3±1) d. The incision size was 2.0-3.5cm. Patients were all satisfied with the scar. After surgery all cases did not use painkillers. 3 cases occurred postoperative transient hoarseness, 1 case occurred subcutaneous emphysema, 12 cases transferred to open surgery because of thyroid carcinoma with cervical lymph node metastasis. All cases had no postoperative bleeding or infection. The whole group were followed up for 3 to 60 months, no recurrences happened. Conclusions Endoscopic-assisted neck minimally invasive thyroid surgery is a practical, low invasive surgery, which has advantages of safety, reliability, less bleeding, less pain, shorter hospital stay, fewer complications and relative cosmetic results. On the basis of mastering certain skills, it has better clinical effects and brighter application prospect.

articleTitle: Cognitive experiment of PACS teaching
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: PACS system provides a digital platform for medical imaging diagnosis by using IT technology. It is an important research direction of biomedical engineering. In order to strengthen the experimental teaching, Shandong University set up PACS education laboratories, create the cognitive experiments. This paper describes the procedures, methods and modules of these experiments. The experiments will open up students' horizons and help them master the specific process of the medical images display, operation and processing.

articleTitle: Design and practice of CAI for experimental class in vocational school
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: The experimental teaching in vocational school is the efficient avenue to enhance the students' quality of experiment and ability of scientific research and train their creativity. At a certain extent, CAI experiments can make up for such shortcomings of traditional experimental classes as lack of cost, long procedure and some ones unrealized. And the simulation experiments by computer in experimental teaching are the counterpart of the real ones. The advantages, types, design methods and defects are introduced in this thesis beginning with analysis of the types of multi-media in experimental class, and the methods and steps to make CAI are emphasized on. The hope is to draw lessons for other experimental classes in vocational school to make CAI and stimulate the interest and creativity of the students, so the teaching quality will be enhanced in vocational school.

articleTitle: Analysis and improvements of PEAP protocol in WLAN
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: In recent years, with more extensive application of WLAN, its security issues are also increasingly receiving widespread attention. To achieve security, a secure authentication mechanism is needed first of all. With detailed analysis of authentication process of PEAP (protected extensible authentication protocol, PPP) in IEEE802.1x authentication mechanism, this article pointed out its defects, and proposed possible improvement programs.

articleTitle: Application practice and analysis research of RFID technology in digital library
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: In recent years, with the development of RFID technology and the reduction of application cost of it, the application of RFID technology is more widely used by library in China. And its application has brought profound changes on the library's management and daily operation and it also provides new technical ways and means for library work. This paper attempts to sum up the practical experience of application for library intelligence collection system of RFID technology used in the library of Chengdu Sports University to provide reference on introduction and application of RFID technology for other universities, especially for small and medium-sized college library.

articleTitle: Application of E-learning in community education
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: E-learning is a new learning way which is an important support to the conduct of community education. On the basis of elaborating E- learning and community education contents, this paper analysis the advantages of E-learning applied in community education and shows the specific application strategies: enhancing organization and management in learning, effectively allocating digital learning resources, innovative supply of community education resource. It is a reference to better promote our community education overall development.

articleTitle: Research on the countermeasure about enhancing service industry competitiveness in Liaoning's three regions
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: In recent years, service industry in Liaoning province has been developed rapidly, and the tertiary industry accounted for about 40 percent of local GDP. This paper constructed the index system of service industry competitiveness based on the theory of the services industry and service industry competitiveness, analyses and calculates on the service industry's competitiveness of Liaoning province's cities by the factor analysis method, according to the factor analysis results and the advantages and disadvantages of development, and puts forward the policies and measures to further enhance the development of service industry in Liaoning province's three regions-Shenyang Economic Zone, Coastal Economic Belt and Liaoning Northwest Area.

articleTitle: The state diagram programming on sequential logic design
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: The structure of state diagram or state table of sequential logic, completely determines the ultimate logic action of of sequential machines. This article on how to obtain accurate and correct logic state transitions and output relationship, summarized by original design methods and design experiences, proposed new design ideals and new specific algorithm in the traditional design field. Enrich and strengthen the integrity of the sequential logic design methods.

articleTitle: An analysis on relevant factors of public receiving life-long education—Based on Zhejiang province investigation
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: This paper aims to make a research on the contents, motivations, learning time and payments of public receiving life-long education through a descriptive way; some related analysis will be on the relationship between four factors (age, income, diploma, and gender) and motivations and payments. A series of constructive suggestions will be proposed based on the findings.

articleTitle: Digital watermarking technique for digital medical images
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: With the development of information technique, the power of image processing software become stronger, and we can edit the digital images more easily. So the copyright protection, the integrity authentication of digital image becomes an urgent issue. At the same time, the rapid development of medical technique, there are more and more digital images, and they need be preserved, transmitted, an so on. However, the copyright of it should be researched. And the contents of digital medical images contain more important information, and any change of it may result in physiotherapy accident. How to authenticate the digital images' reality and integrity become so important that we should use new technique to protect them. Digital watermarking is a technique that embeds important data into host multimedia, and it can be used in digital right management, authentication and data hiding. In this paper, we will analyze the character of medical images and watermarking technique. And give the basic procedure of them, and analyze the performance of these algorithms.

articleTitle: Driving special interest group via project & cultivating talents to be expert in one thing and good at many
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: On the difficult problem of college students employment, we deeply analyze questions in the popularization progress of our country's higher education, and difference between talents needed and those trained in university. Then, according to our own advantages, we present talents training model of “driving special interest group via project & cultivating talents to be expert in one thing and good at many” based on the mode of “good foundation and wide knowledge”. Over the years, Shandong Province Key Laboratory of Digital Media has developed a new route for practicing the model, which is to organize and cultivate the students by the mode of “driving special interest group via project” relying on the advantages of research, project, equipment and personnel. More significantly, the model has now been populated in many universities through the competition of Qilu Undergraduate Contest on Software Design and Foreign Language.

Author Keywords: expert in one thing and good at many

articleTitle: The value of Radionuclide Myocardial Perfusion Imaging in children with viral myocarditis
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: To investigate the value of Radionuclide Myocardial Perfusion Imaging in the children with viral myocarditis (VMC), a set respective study of 121 patients hospitalized for VMC were divided into clinical final diagnose group and suspicious diagnose group. <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">99m</sup>Tc-methoxyisobutylisonitrile (MIBI) myocardial perfusion imaging was performed in all patients. 33/61 cases were abnormal in clinical diagnose group, 20/ 60 cases were abnormal in suspicious diagnose group. There was significant difference between two groups (χ<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>=5.30, P<;60;0.05). The most common injured segments were located at anterior wall, followed at Inferior wall and lateral wall. Enlarged ventricle were detected in 12/ 61 patients of diagnose groups and in 4/60 patients of suspicious diagnose groups. There was significant difference between two groups (χ<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>=4.46, P<;60;0.05). Positive detection rate and ventricular expansion of <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">99m</sup>Tc-MIBI myocardial perfusion imaging in different stages of clinical diagnosis groups were the highest in the acute phase, lower in convalescence and chronic stages, there were significant differences (P <;0.05). Mocardial perfusion imaging-positive patients restored normal or improved markedly six months after the treatment in the follow-up. In conclusion, as a non-Invasive and safe method, <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">99m</sup>Tc-MIBI myocardial imaging has a better positive detection rate for the myocardial damage caused by myocarditis, can observed directly the location, extent and degree of myocardial damage of VMC, and the positive rate is related to course of the disease. It plays an important role in clinical diagnosis, evaluation of treatment, prognosis and follow-up.

articleTitle: Design of an information platform of performance evaluation for essential medicines using system
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: Global health care has been facing the irrational use of medicines, which has caused high medical costs and health hazards. China has launched the implementation of National Essential Drug System (NEDS) since 2009 for the rational use of medicines. To set up and manage an effective NEDS, a performance evaluation system is much needed. In this paper, we present the design of such an information platform model and discuss the development process of performance evaluation indicator system. The Balanced Score Card (BSC) method was adopted and modified to have financial index, patient index, professional process index, and development and blazing new trials index. The proposed information platform is based on the construction of residents' electronic health files (EHR), and will be further tested and optimized in a regional health care situation.

articleTitle: The research of anti-aging herbals classification using self-organizing neural network
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: In Chinese ancient herbal book records a lot anti-aging health herbals that can prolong life, this paper take the nature, flavors, meridian distribution and effect of them as the classification indicator, and use the self organizing feature map neural network (SOFM) to quantify multidimensional information of basic properties of anti-aging herbal and map to the corresponding topological network structure. Clustering based on the overall characteristics of herbals, and it is the first trying of using the Euler distance to metric effect similarity between herbals. The model not only can accurately judge the herbal classification, but also be a new method for discovery of potential anti-aging herbals that have not been recognized in traditional Chinese medicine.

articleTitle: A purpose-based privacy-aware access control mechanism for distributed medical documents sharing
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: This paper presents the privacy-aware data access control and medical documents sharing mechanism based on purpose for distributed XML medical databases. A privacy access policy for XML is a tree-like model, and a group of distributed XML medical databases corresponding to a group of distributed policy trees, so we should mine the integrated patterns to control private data access in sharing environments. Firstly, we should sequence the policy trees and mine the integrated patterns. Secondly, we calculate the privacy information using entropy to identify the integrated patterns with larger information. At last, we query distributed medical documents using integrated patterns, which shares as many as possible private data on condition of privacy constraints. The experiments show that based on different privacy demands for different applications, entropy calculation can be the basis of the choice for integrated pattern and access data reasonably without privacy disclosure.

articleTitle: Preparation and biological performance evaluation of Lactoferrin/ Nanosized hydroxyapatite/ Collagen I composite material
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: Objective: To prepare and analyse Lactoferrin/Nanosized hydroxyapatite/Collagen I (CMs-loaded LF/nHA/Co-I) composite materials. Methods: Tripolyphosphate (TPP) was used as cross-linker to make CMs-loaded LF. nHA was prepared through chemical precipitation. Collagen I (Co- I) was extracted from fresh bovine tendon through acid dissolution and protease digestion. CMs, nHA and collagen could be crosslinked by Genipin to be tissue engineering materials. The composite materials would be tested by scanning electron microscopy (SEM), enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay (ELISA), immunohistochemistry, X-ray analysis, infrared spectroscopy, average bone density X-ray and analysis by computer software. Results: Genipin could effectively crosslink CNs, nHA and collagen together to form engineering material to repair bone defect.

Author Keywords: DIGORA Optime Intraoral dental film digital imaging systems

articleTitle: Complex networks and its application in education resources network
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: Education resources network is a typical complex network. On the basis of introduction to the concepts of complex network, it analyzed the current situation of complex networks and its application in education resources network, especially concentrated on models and evolvement mechanism of network, in the domestic, and so on. At last, it proposed the next research of complex network and its application on Internet.

articleTitle: An E-learning system based on mobile agent
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: The increasing requirements of education, reduction of study cost and no location limits study have encouraged developers providing e-learning systems. In E-learning system, identity verification of the learner is an important part of the operation of e-learning security. In this paper we combine mobile agent and e-learning system and define a new E-learning system which has a mobile agent named Client Agent and a static agent. The Client Agent works at the client, inspects the packets including the learner's private information, signs the legal ones and guards them to the network server. So the packets can go through the network firewall without decryption. This system makes the learner's private information safer.

articleTitle: Texture self-similarity measure method and its application
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: According to the definition of texture and the self-similar characteristics of texture, we introduce the quantify method which computes the texture self-similarity from the structure and appearance details. This method can effectively distinguish the obvious structural textures, and the results of this method and the subjective evaluation results are consistent. In addition, we give two applications: the texture category and the evaluation of texture synthesis results.

articleTitle: Application of SELDI technique: Salivary protein fingerprint spectrum in the diagnosis of thyroid cancer
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: Objective: Using surface-enhanced laser desorption/ionization (SELDI) mass spectrometry to test the salivary protein fingerprint from the patients with thyroid cancer, benign nodular goiter and healthy subjects, to screen out the differentially expressed proteins between each group, and establish a diagnostic model with the help of bioinformatics to provide a novel approach for the early diagnosis of thyroid cancer. Methods: Saliva protein fingerprints of 49 patients with thyroid cancer, 34 patients with nodular goiter and 43 healthy subjects were tested using SEDLI technique. Specific differentially expressed proteins in the saliva of thyroid cancer patient were screened out and a diagnostic model was established with the help of bioinformatics. Results: The total accuracy of the cross validation (test group) for the diagnostic model of thyroid cancer and health control was 81.8% (72/88), sensitivity 88.9% (40/45), specificity 74.4% (32/43); The total accuracy of the cross validation (test group) for the diagnostic model of thyroid cancer and nodular goiter was 89.1% (74/83), sensitivity 87.7%(43/49), specificity 91.1% (31/34). Conclusions: By using SELDI technique, a preliminary diagnostic model for thyroid cancer was established, which may provide a novel approach of high sensitivity and strong specificity for the early diagnosis and pre-operation diagnosis of thyroid cancer. It deserves further investigation and application.

Author Keywords: surface enhanced laser desorption/ionization time-of-flight mass spectrometry (SELDI-TOF-MS)

articleTitle: Research and practice on teaching methods and means of basic courses in signal and information processing curriculum
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: The basic courses in signal and information processing curriculum are very important ones of series courses in Electronic Information disciplines in the Universities. Based on teaching practice, several teaching methods and means are discussed, and if combined them to a certain percentage, it can achieve better teaching results. This combination of teaching methods and means can also be used for other series courses' teaching.

articleTitle: Methods of cultivating competitive talents in the institution of higher education under the background of the information age
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: The advent of the information age lays claim to institutions of higher education on cultivating talents. the institutions should not only stress on the accumulation of knowledge in the pattern of traditional education, but also pay more attention to the social development in the practical sense, develop students' subjective initiative with the modern education digital media technology, and guide students in a correct, simply and efficient way so as to cultivate good study habits and excellent ways of thinking, form a self-motivation mechanism and self-growth ability, and therefore become the most competitive talents in the society.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of synthesizing three-dimensional animation with real image
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: This paper introduces the design and implementation of synthesizing three-dimensional animation with real images. And it presents steps and process of carrying out the synthesizing three-dimensional animation with real images in details. Finally, the reliability and feasibility of this technical method is validated by the simulation experiment.

articleTitle: Development of a web-based training management system to assist training for citizen runners
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: The purpose of this study was to develop a web-based training management system which assists citizen runners to establish the Plan-Do-See Cycle (PDSC) for their training. The developed system, having three major functions namely, training diary function, personal coaching function, and message board function, is available for one hundred concurrent users. Usability, privacy, and security were considered in the system in its development stage. For the system evaluations, this system was utilized by the members of a community sports club which promotes marathon training among citizens for three months. As a result, the number of members using the web-based training diary was more than double compared with the number of the members using paper-based training diary. Moreover, each satisfaction level with the three major functions of the system, was three or more out of a five on average score. In conclusion, we succeeded in developing a web-based training management system which can assist more citizen runners to establish the PDSC for their training.

articleTitle: Interactive multimedia for kanban commercial system
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: Traditional kanban commercial usually obtains the product evaluation through questionnaires. However, it is a waste time and money, and the effect of kanban commercial is not good. In this paper, we develop and combine the interactive media push technology with face recognition system to solve the commercial statistical problem and the effect. The paper system will capture the person's face for concentration to watch the real time advertisement monitor picture or movie. Then, we can depend on the position of the face to make corresponding action that attract person to continue watching. At the same time, this system can save the information of people flow count to database for avoiding to count the same person repeatedly. When the end client(interaction), system will use the mobile phone system to send the user a text message that coupon of advertising goods, user take this text message to buy goods, increase the effect of advertising. We integrated facial features characteristics with Adaboost algorithm realized face recognition, using Adaboost algorithm can further improve precision of face detection.

articleTitle: Correlation of aberrant methylation of p16 gene to MTHFR C677T genetic polymorphisms in Hepatic Carcinoma
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: Object: To investigate the association between aberrant hypermethylation of p16 gene and methylenetetrahydrofolate reductase (MTHFR) genetic polymorphisms in Hepatic Carcinoma. Method: Hepatic Carcinoma cancer tissues and paracancerous normal tissues were collected. CpG island methylation status of p16 gene and MTHFR gene polymorphisms were analyzed by Real-time quantitative polymerase chain reaction (Real-time PCR). The associations between methylation status of P16 gene and clinical characteristics as well as MTHFR C677T polymorphisms were analyzed. Results: Among 86 HCC patients, the berrant hypermethylation rate of P16 gene was 60.5% in cancer tissues and 2.3% in paracancerou normal tissues. The aberrant hypermethylation rate of p16 gene in tumorous tissues was significantly higher than that in paracancerou normal tissues (χ<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>=67.48, p<0.05). Patients with positive HBsAg had greater significantly p16 gene methylation frequencies (χ<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>=5.60, p<0.05). No association was found between P16 gene methylation and selected factors including sex, age, smoking, alcohol drinking and tumor size. Compared with the MTHFR 677CC genotype, the odds ratio (OR) and 95% confidence interval (95%CI) of p16 gene with MTHFR 677T allele were 3.47(1.06 ∼ 11.37) (p<0.05). Conclution: MTHFR C677T polymorphism may be associated with hypermethylation of p16 gene, and MTHFR C677T polymorphisms may be involved in methylation-related carcinogenesis in the liver.

articleTitle: Integrating imageology with computer technology to improve neuroanatomy teaching effect
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: This paper argues that we should pay attention to the basic concept in the process of teaching by using the comparison methods, the formula method, the drawing method and teaching AIDS, So it is very useful to visualize the content vividly; we integrate imageology into computer technology, and make it which combined with the traditional teaching methods visualized; And also introduce relevant clinical symptom and something new knowledge of neuroanatomy, those methods can help the students understanding the basic knowledge system, mobilize their enthusiasm for studying. Thus the student study from passively to active learning, and improve the quality of teaching.

articleTitle: Design and synthesis of the novel antibacterial agent 8-bromo-1,1-dimethyl-1,3,4,9-tetrahydropyrano[3,4-b]indole and its derivatives
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: Indoles, a group of alkaloids, showed a wide range of biological activities. Recently, there is a growing tendency to develop some new methods for the synthesis of novel indoles derivatives and to study their biological properties. In this paper, we like to report the design and synthesis of a novel series of tricyclic indoles through several efficient reactions, such as acylation, Pictet-Spengler reaction (P-S reaction) and so on. All these new target compound were synthesized in seven steps with the total yield of 11%-15%, All the products and important intermediates were characterized by <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sup>HNMR and LC-MS spectrum.

articleTitle: HDL3 protects vascular endothelial cells from lipopolysaccharide- induced injure by inhibiting the NF-κB-mediated inflammatory reaction
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: [Purpose] To investigate the effects and potential mechanisms of preconditioning of high-density lipoprotein (HDL3) on lipopolysaccharide (LPS)-induced injure to human umbilical vein endothelial cells (HUVEC). [Methods] HUVECs were pretreated with HDL3 at the concentration of 50 or 100 or 200mg/L for 18 hours, washed and stimulated with LPS (1.0 mg/L) for additional 6 hours. Cell viability was measured by MTT assay. Annexin V/PI double staining was used to measure the cell apoptotic rate by flow cytometry. The numbers of THP-1 adhesion to HUVECs were observed under fluorescence microscope and the content of VCAM-1 in culture medium was measured by ELISA. The level of NF-κB p65 in cell nuclei was determined by Western blotting. [Results] LPS reduced cell viability and induced apoptosis in HUVECs. The cytotoxic effects of LPS were significantly inhibited by HDL3 pretreatment. In addition, HDL3 also significantly suppressed the LPS-induced adhesion of THP-1 to HUVECs. Meanwhile, exposure of HUVECs to LPS resulted in a significant increase in the levels of VCAM-1 in culture media and NF-κB p65 in cell nuclei. HDL3 blocked these effects in a concentration-dependent manner. [Conclusion] HDL3 can protect HUVECs from LPS-induced injure and the mechanism at least partially involves its ability to suppress the secretion of VCAM-1 and the activation of NF-κB.

articleTitle: Improved graph clustering algorithm for logistics company alliance building problem
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: Logistics company alliance building problem studies that how to build alliance with a method of great rate and low cost. It presents an improved algorithm about graph clustering base on PSO to solve the problem. Optimize the clustering result through PSO, and expand the solution space through disturbance strategies in order to obtain the optimal solution. Experimental result shows that the algorithm can solve the problem in a high rate and low cost.

articleTitle: A collaborative simulation monitor system of ship based on patterns
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: Computer simulation has been widely used in scientific research. But the present simulation systems are mostly designed for a specific purpose, which can only be applied in specific research experiment, so the expansibility is not good. The main purpose of pattern technology is to extend the technologies of software reuse based on Object Oriented <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">[1]</sup>. Pattern technology can reuse not only the codes of function modules, but also the structural design of system software. In the design and implementation of the collaborative ship simulation monitor system mentioned in this paper, kinds of pattern technologies have been used. The system has not just the characteristics of high efficiency, easy to extend and maintain, but also the characteristic of high reusability.

articleTitle: A feasibility study to investigate the techniques for 3D reconstruction of brachial plexus and its surrounding structures using visible human dataset
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: Thoracic Outlet Syndrome (TOS) is a common surgical disease, which will cause certain symptoms like neck-shoulder pain, headache, numbness of the upper limb and so on. Many of those symptoms are derived from brachial plexus entrapment. That syndrome is hard to diagnose in clinic. We need some direct evidence of the disease. Yet, the visualization of peripheral nerve like brachial plexus is still a tough problem. Presently, corresponding researches usually built their foundation on cadaver autopsy. In the study, a three dimensional (3-D) model of brachial plexus and its surrounding structures was established by segmentation of Chinese visible human (CVH) data. As a result, it is found brachial plexus went through a narrow tunnel surrounded by bone, muscle and tendon-like tissues. And, at its root and division sections that “tunnel” has been greatly compromised. Our findings indicate the potential sources and location of the disease, which may help to clinical diagnosis and treatment.

articleTitle: The regression equation for the patients with IgA nephropathy in clinical research
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: Aims: In order to look for an objective methods to illustrate the condition of renal function changes, we analyze the correlation between the levels of cytokines/chemokines and the severity of renal function for the patient with IgAN. Methods: A total of 26 patients were applied by a novel design to analyze blood and urinary cytokines/chemokines, everyone of them were diagnosed IgA nephropathy (IgAN) by renal biopsy. Blood and urine samples were taken from patients after signing the informed consent. All of the ingredients were tested by using enzyme- linked immunosorbent assay (ELISA). Results: The renal function can be calculated by the regression equation. It was shown that the levels of monocyte chemoattractant protein (MCP)-1, transforming growth factor-β (TGF-β)-1, the main composition of extracellular matrix (MC-ECM) such as collagen IV (col IV) , laminin (LN), hyaluronic acid (HA) and precollagen III (PIIINP) in patients with IgAN had different correlation with the condition of renal function. By the regression equation, we can monitor the change of renal function. Conclusion: Our study is the first to provide an utility regression equation as a way to monitor the condition of renal function to the patients with IgAN. By the regression equation, we would use it to find the severity and the change of renal function in early period.

articleTitle: Determination of l-menthol in Qingxuanwan by callipary GC
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: [Purpose] To develop an GC method for content determination of l-menthol in Qingxuanwan. [Methods] The sample was determinated by GC after being extracted by ethanol with ultrasonic extractor. The GC-FID experiments were performed on an Aglient 6890N GC equipped with flame ionization detector (FID). DB-WAX column (30 m × 0.25 mm, 0.25μm) was used. The injector, column and detecto rtemperatures were 250°C, 160°C and 250°Crespectively. The samples were injected by split mode. The ratio of split was 5:1. The flow rate was 1.0 ml/min. The injection volume was 2 μl. [Results] The average recovery was 98.0% and RSD was 0.7%(n=6). [Conclusion] The method is proved to be sensitive and accurate, and can be used to control the quality of Qingxuanwan.

articleTitle: In vitro study on the metabolism of epigallocatechin gallate (EGCG) in mouse's tissues
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: The study was designed to investigate the characters of metabolism of epigallocatechin gallate (EGCG) in mouse's tissues, basing on establishing a RP-HPLC method for determination of EGCG. And the results showed that there was a good linearity over the range 0.1-200.0 mg/L (r>;0.999). The recoveries were more than 85.0% in all tissue samples, and the intra- and inter-day coefficients of variation were less than 10.0% in all cases. So the RPHPLC method was readily applied for quantitative analysis of EGCG in rats' tissue samples. And it was fastest for metabolism of EGCG in plasma. But the metabolism of EGCG in tissue homogenates varied a lot. It was metabolized slowly in liver homogenate, while it was metabolized comparatively fast in small intestine and large intestine homogenates. And the pH value in large intestine played an important role in the metabolism of EGCG. Therefore, basing on the establishment of method for determination of EGCG in rat's intestine and feces, the characters of metabolism of EGCG were clarified, so as to provide a basic theory for exploring the metabolic fate and develop an advanced preparation of EGCG.

articleTitle: The exploration and practice in innovative personnel training of Computer Science and Technology
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: In this paper, the author expounded on the investigation and understanding in the innovative ability of the contemporary college students, and introduced their practical experience and concrete measures in theoretical teaching, practice teaching, graduation design and technological innovation activities in the specialty of the Computer Science and Technology.

articleTitle: Research of knowledge transmission among the enterprise clusters based on cognitive perspective
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: The knowledge structure of the enterprise in cluster causes the difference among cognitive perspectives. In order to overcome the deficiency that the existing researches couldn't describe well the knowledge structure of enterprises, this paper proposed the knowledge transmission model among enterprise clusters based on cognitive perspective. The model proposed the definition of enterprise chromosome based on cognitive perspective, gave the learning strategies and knowledge interactive mechanism by referring to ant colony path selection. Simulations results indicate that the knowledge transmission within a cluster has the principle of cognitive proximity and the knowledge transfer probability is higher when the knowledge structure of two enterprises are similar.

articleTitle: Reform for experiment system of mechanical design manufacturing and its automation
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: Experimental teaching is an important segment to cultivate students' innovation ability. In order to make the experiment segment systematic, the experimental system structure of mechanical design manufacturing and its automation major, including fundamental experiment and major experiment, is constructed. Fundamental experiment cultivate students the basic experiment ability. Around the mechanical and electrical product development, major experiment exercises students' comprehensive utilization knowledge ability. Take miniature lathe as object, the experiment system is implemented and satisfied result is achieved.

articleTitle: Determination of residual organic solvents in pharmaceuticals by headspace gas chromatography
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: A determination method of residual solvents in pharmaceutical products by headspace gas chromatography has been established and optimized. Eight solvents which belong to the guideline for residual solvents regulated by the International Conference on Harmonization were studied. Under optimum conditions, various components were separated completely. This novel method was applied to the analysis of volatile residual solvents in pharmaceutical products with satisfactory results. The method is simple, accurate and reliable, which can be used to detect the residual solvents in pharmaceutical products.

articleTitle: The application of information push technology in clinical medicine education
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: Based on the characteristics of information push technology, in this article, it researchs the information active push center which be constructed by PushMail, SMS Server, Rss. It's in order to search for a personal initiative information service system in clinical medicine education in the future.

articleTitle: Challenges in designing a successful e-health system for Australia
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: In this paper we contextualize the introduction of the Personally Controlled Electronic Health Records (PCEHRs) in Australia using the lens of relevant constructs identified in the literature of technology acceptance models and Information Systems success models. We provide a timely and up to date review of the challenges faced by PCEHRs implementation in Australia. It confirms the relevance of these systems to improve healthcare delivery and the general stakeholder's support for its implementation. However there are tremendous challenges to overcome towards a widely adopted and successful e-health system in Australia.

articleTitle: Mining open source text documents for intelligence gathering
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: Intelligence collection and analysis always play a major role in a company's growth. Traditional intelligence management process was most concealed and required massive human effort. It also has the disadvantages of rarity and danger. Therefore open source intelligence (OSINT) emerged as a major intelligence collection and analysis approach. Differing from traditional approach, the sources of OSINT are publicly accessible and have the properties of openness and massiveness which may result in disadvantages of inconsistency and lack of validation. For now, most of the OSINT processing is conducted manually which requires massive human effort and time cost. Automatic processing of OSINT is then unavoidable for modern applications. Although there exists software services to aid such automatic processing, the functionality and degree of automation are still immature and limited. In this work we developed an automatic processing approach for OSINT based on proposed text mining techniques. This approach may automatically identify interesting events from various aspects from which business could benefit. The major contribution of this work is that we have developed high-order mining techniques for OSINT, which will benefit domains like national security, personal knowledge management, business intelligence, e-learning, etc.

articleTitle: Challenges and rewards in the implementation of an ePortfolio project in a Higher Education Institution in Hong Kong
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: This article describes the author's experiences with facilitating an ePortfolio project in a Hong Kong Higher Education Institution (HEI) as well as her reflections on this project. Firstly, the impact on Hong Kong HEIs brought about by various educational policies in recent years is described. Next, the major types of ePortfolios in the Higher Education sector are examined as discovered in existing literature. The last section deals with the backgrounds of the College and the ePortfolio project, the challenges that the author as the project-manager has faced, as well as the rewards brought to both the students and the faculty through the implementation of this project. It is hoped that this article could help stimulate discussions of how ePortfolios could benefit and play a key role in enhancing the learning environment of both teachers and students under the new educational reform in Hong Kong.

articleTitle: Transient behavior experiments for hybrid fuel cell-battery systems
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: This study presents the transient behavior of a PEM fuel cell-battery system by experiments. The dynamic characterizations of this hybrid fuel cell-battery system with a single dc/dc boost converter were investigated by experiments under a step-up power load. It was found that the pure fuel cell power system transient response to a steady level after a period time exhibits a current overshoot. This was followed by a voltage undershoot behavior because of a step increase in power due to the inherent time delay experienced by the redistribution of membrane water content with a response time order of 8~29 seconds. The redistribution of membrane water content caused a rapid drop in cell voltage with a time delay of 22.40 seconds, calculated by δ<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>/D<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">w</sub>, which is in agreement with the experimental results. Finally, some experimental results are presented for verifying the effectiveness of the proposed fuel cell-battery systems with a single dc/dc boost converter that could improve the overshoot and undershoot responses on fuel cell.

articleTitle: A phone-based e-health system for OSAS and its energy issue
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: Obstructive Sleep Apnea Syndrome (OSAS) is a widespread sleep-disordered breathing disease, which leads to repetitive hypoxemia, hypercapnia and interruptions of the normal sleep pattern. Considering its severe negative impact on human health, long-term monitoring of OSAS is necessary. Current OSAS monitoring systems require patients to stay in the hospital overnight and need considerable wiring between human body and the system. In this work, we propose a smartphone-based, wireless e-health system designed for OSAS. Our design offers a portable system that enables anytime and anywhere monitoring. Our experiments and modeling show that energy efficiency is the major bottleneck for sustainable operations of this battery-driven system. On the solution side, we can make full use of the low-power mode of Bluetooth, which is proved to be the energy bottleneck. The lifetime of the resulting OSAS system would increase by more than 50%. Our ongoing work seeks to take a holistic approach to more energy-efficient system.

articleTitle: Comparing physician and hospital manager perceptions of medical knowledge management systems success
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: The study is to explore the perceptions of physicians and hospital managers on the key success factors (KSF) of a medical knowledge management system (MKMS). A survey approach was conducted in four medical centers in Taiwan. A total of 340 questionnaires, including 15 for hospital managers and 70 for physicians in each hospital, were administered. Two-hundred four questionnaires responses were received, with a 60% effective response rate. Hospital managers and physicians were testified separately as various samples. Partial least square was used to analyze the data. The results found that both groups indicated user factors and policy factors as the direct factors of MKMS performance. Knowledge quality is regarded as an antecedent to user factors, while system quality is the antecedent to both user and policy factors. However, system software and hardware was supported only by managers; and organizational factors were supported only by physicians. The results reveal the high consensus between physicians and hospital managers. Political interventions could have significant effect on adoption and implementation of MKMS. Second, the study provides hospital managers additional insights into physician requirements for organizational support. Third, more physician participation and involvement are necessary when introducing and developing a MKMS.

articleTitle: A research on the management incentive mechanism of the Chinese corporations
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: The research on corporate governance is being developed from reducing agency cost to playing incentive mechanism. Being different from the western, the Chinese corporations were born out of the planned economic system, and the modern corporate system with the Chinese characteristics is still being established, explored and completed. According to the related theories and literatures, incentive mechanism of corporate governance, as an institutional factor, plays an important role in the corporation innovation and development. Taking the Chinese listed companies as samples, this paper investigates the development and present status of the management incentive mechanism of the Chinese companies. And based on the theories, literatures and research trend about incentive mechanism of corporate governance, this paper puts forward some proposals for the future research on how to improve the management incentive mechanism of the Chinese companies.

articleTitle: NXT information and control on test dimensionality using Kolb's innovative learning cycle
