publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: Lego has been popular for a long time. In the last few years, Lego has released a programmable module, which many educational organizations and micro-operation robots have used. This has given rise to a new topic of study, how to use Lego NXT in education. In this paper, we present an application of Lego NXT in the subject of mathematics. The principle is based on Kolb's innovative learning cycle, that the student's active learning and cooperative learning concepts complete the whole process of learning experience. In order to compare the effectiveness of learning, we use an experimental group and a control group, and give then pre- and post-tests.

articleTitle: The utilisation of IS evaluation a HIS case study
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: Evaluation is important to the success of IS projects. Research shows that effective evaluation of IS projects can be useful to organizations in both the short and longer terms and can serve multiple purposes. However, in practice IS evaluation is often used in an ad hoc manner. This study attempts to raise awareness of the use of evaluation by investigating how IS evaluation is actually used in practice. Through a brief literature review of aspects of IS evaluation use and the role of stakeholders in evaluation, a theoretical framework for describing the relationship between stakeholder involvement, evaluation outcomes and process, and the use of evaluation is proposed. A case study of a HIS project of a local hospital in China is conducted to illustrate the components of the framework. One major finding is the identification of the details of instrumental, conceptual and symbolic use of HIS project evaluation.

articleTitle: Free radial forearm flaps: An overview of our clinical experience and exploration of relevant issues
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: Free radial forearm flaps have many advantages and thus remain the dominant multi-purpose flap used in the reconstruction of maxillofacial soft tissue defects. This report summarizes our experience over 20 years of applying free radial forearm flaps and illustrates four stages of technical improvement regarding the selection of the anastomotic veins at the donor site and at the recipient site in addition to the choice of the method to be used for flap harvest. We believe that the key to improving the transplantation success rate for free radial forearm flaps is based on the following factors. First, the branches of the internal jugular vein are the preferred targets for anastomosis at the recipient site. Second, during flap harvest, it is necessary to retain the external fascia between the arteries and veins. Third, it is necessary to select veins in two vascular systems of different depths for concurrent anastomosis.

articleTitle: Research on an generalized L-system method
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: The traditional L-system is a parallel string-rewriting system in which the production of branch structure is different from the growth of stems while developing the morphology of plants. The grammar system about structure of plants is generated by an iterative procedure, and eventually is visualized by using Turtle interpretation to simulate a virtual plant. The method is lack of intuitive biological meaning in simulating the dynamic process of plant growth. A generalized L-system method is proposed in this paper. In this method, substructure is the unit of growth with physiological age and chronological age, and the dynamic growth is manifested by the hidden Markov procedure, and then the developed plants have the stochastic quality in accordance with botanical principles. Finally, a given instance shows the proposed method is quick and effective in modeling plants.

articleTitle: QSAR modeling of human TAP-binding peptide based on amino acid properties
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: The transporter associated with antigen processing (TAP) is essential for peptide delivery from the cytosol into the lumen of the endoplasmic reticulum (ER), where these peptides are loaded on a major histocompatibility complex (MHC) I molecules and form peptide-MHC complex. The peptide-MHC leaves the ER and displays their antigenic cargo on the cell surface to cytotoxic T cells and recognized by T-cell receptor. In this study, 89 physicochemical properties of amino acid were used to characterize the peptides which were binding to TAP. Then, quantitative structural activity relationship (QSAR) model was constructed by multiple linear regressions (MLR) with the parameters, which had significant contribution for affinity and screened by the stepwise regression (STR). The QSAR model had good reliability (Q<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>=0.663) and predictive ability (R<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">test</inf><sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>=0.673). The normalized regression coefficients (NRC) of the QSAR model could demonstrate the contributions of specific position for affinity and discovery the dominant amino acid TAP binding peptide. Therefore, the QSAR model constructed by STR-MLR has many advantages, such as, easier calculation and explanation, good performance, and definite physiochemical indication, which could be used to guide the design and modification of the TAP binding peptide.

articleTitle: A study on the application of gestalt theory to task design in English teaching of vocational & Technical Colleges
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: There exist many good and praiseworthy achievements in the field of task design and professor Nunan's accomplishment in this field is one of the most prominent. He has not only provided us with a theoretical framework for studying and designing tasks in communicative classroom but also offered a series of practical principles in task design for a comprehensive language course. In China, the study and application of task design is increasingly widespread. However, many teachers still encounter the problem that the tasks well designed in advance can not be carried out smoothly in classroom teaching. Because of the lack of the spirit of working hard for a long time, the ones from vocational college have already transferred their interests to other aspects and English learning is a big headache for them. Therefore, it is urgent for teachers to know how to make task design and task implementation more applicable to English classroom of vocational colleges. Adjusting the task steps and offering psychological implications according to Gestalt psychology theories can increase the realism of the task in psychological field. The unity of two fields can stimulate, maintain and improve the learning interest with which the students can be naturally integrated into the tasks.

articleTitle: NF-κB and p38 MAPK: Major regulators in skeletal muscle development
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: Nuclear factor kappa B (NF-κB) and p38 mitogen-activated protein kinase (p38 MAPK) are intimately related to skeletal muscle abnormalities. Since that, an interest has been found to investigate their functions in skeletal muscle development. Skeletal muscle development is a very complicated process involving cell differentiation, apoptosis, protein synthesis and degradation. Previous studies indicated that NF-κB acted as dule roles in skeletal muscle differentiation, by contrast, p38 MAPK is a clear regulator in promoting this process. Recently, an intriguing field of investigating the cross talk between NF-κB and p38 MAPK is emerging, and to further complete the picture between NF-κB and p38 MAPK will be filled with prospect. So, the most recent reports on this aspect are included in this paper.

articleTitle: EGFR-mediated DSB repair pathway in radiosensitization of rectal cancer
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: The expression of the epidermal growth factor receptor (EGFR) contributes to radiosensitivity in several cancers, including rectal cancer. However, little is known about the mechanism underlying its radiosensitivity effect. To explore the mechanism, rectal cancer cell line HCT-15 with knockdown of EGFR was established through shRNA. The depletion of EGFR not only inhibited the cell proliferation and focus formation, but also induced cycle blockage of G0/G1 stage and enhanced radiosensitivity. In addition, the mRNA levels of key components involved in NHEJ pathway were significantly down regulated, including Ligase IV, DNA-PKcs and KU 80. EGFR- mediated NHEJ pathway may be involved in rectal cancer radiosensitivity.

articleTitle: Research on E-learning pattern in higher education
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: E-learning which uses the modern information technology method, realizes one kind of ideal learning environment and a new brand and fully manifesting students' main body function learning way, through the effective conformity between information technology and the discipline curriculum. This article starts from the disadvantages of the traditional teaching pattern, analyzes the characteristics and the future developing trend of E-learning teaching pattern, then analyzes the technical support needed in E-learning, at last introduces the requirements to teachers and students in the E-learning teaching pattern.

articleTitle: Investigation of human brucellosis in Tuquan
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: To investigate the current status of human brucellosis in Tuquan country, Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region. The epidemiology survey method and standard questionnaire was adopted to explore epidemiological characteristic of human brucellosis among cases and controls. 801 new cases were reported during 2010-2011 in Tuquan country, male patients are more than female patients; Most of the cases were between 30 years old and 60 years old; New cases were found in every villages of Tuque country, the incidence of brucellosis was statistical significant deference between villages; The peak period of incidence is June and July. Close surveillance of the brucellosis should be performed to prevent the expansion of the epidemic.

articleTitle: The construction on the quality assurance system of network teaching
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: The teaching quality is the lifeline of the network teaching, and establishes a comprehensive network teaching quality assurance system is the vital way to protect the university's network teaching sustained and healthy development. To build a network teaching system, has major immediate significance to promote the effective design of network teaching system and improve the quality of network teaching.

articleTitle: The impact of IT on curricula design of Information Management and Information System Doctoral Education in China
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: Although there are a lot of researches on Information Management and Information System education in China, little research is done in examining the impact of IT on doctoral curricula by Information Management and Information System programs in China to reveal: what courses are offered? what is the most popular subject area? how Information Management and Information System schools change their curricula to meet today's challenges? In order to address above questions, this study gives a brief summary of the curricula of Information Management and Information System doctoral programs in China. Findings show that there is no national consensus of what should be the core of the Information Management and Information System discipline for PhD education in China. The largest percentage of the courses offered relate to Management Science and Engineering. Interdisciplinarity is also featured within the Information Management and Information System PhD curricula in China.

articleTitle: K-Pool: A knowledge management platform for digital educational resources sharing
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: Knowledge sharing among teachers, researchers and students in higher educational institutions plays an important role to improve learning and to stimulate new and creative insight. However, the knowledge in such institutions are basically scattered stored and thus inaccessible to others. Therefore a knowledge management platform is necessary to improve systematic and effective knowledge sharing. The paper aims at providing a versatile knowledge management platform to connect knowledge, knowledge seekers and knowledge providers. The K-Pool is introduced as a practical knowledge management platform for digital educational resources sharing in higher educational institutions.

articleTitle: A comparison of Chinese and American nonverbal communication
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: Nonverbal communication is influenced by different cultures. People should pay more attention to it. In the actual process of communication, nonverbal communication is more important than verbal communication. This paper makes a comparison between Chinese and American nonverbal communication to show similarities and differences. Some methods and measures to avoid differences and to make the communication smooth are mentioned in the paper too.

articleTitle: The clinical research of creatine phosphate sodium and enalaprial towards the reversal of early renal injure
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: Objective: To observe the effect of creatine phosphate sodium (Italian Alfa Wassermann product) and enalapril towards the reversal of early renal injure. Methods: 66 cases of early renal injury patients were randomly divided into a treatment group (n = 45) and a control group (n = 21). Both were given enalapril 10mg orally twice a day on the basis of treating the primary diseases. The treatment group was also given creatine phosphate sodium 2.0g IV daily. Urine microalbumin (MAU) and N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminidase (NAG) of the morning urine of both groups were checked before and after two weeks treatment regime. The results: After the treatment, MAU and NAG in both groups reduced, but the change is more evident and statistically significant in treatment group. Conclusion: Creatine phosphate sodium exhibits a significant protective effect on renal injury. With the combination of enalapril in treatment, creatine phosphate sodium is superior to enalapril alone.

articleTitle: Transparent computing: From concept to implementation
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: Traditional computer systems, such as PCs, are facing several challenges, such as complex maintenance & management, low security, and less mobility. With the increasing demands for service and mobility, the computing infrastructure is looking for new technologies and practices to find solution to this problem. We proposed the concept of transparent computing, in which the software and hardware are decoupled where computation are carried out in client machines, but the storage of software, data, and status are centralized on the central servers and delivered on demand to clients in a streaming way. To implement such a system, we use two key technologies: bare-metal and asymmetric virtual machine monitor (AVMM) and Internet virtual disk. AVMM is dedicatedly designed as a light-weighted partitioning system to enable client virtualization and computation with very little virtualization overhead, especially in support of graphic-intensive applications. The Internet virtual disk whose content is stored on the server and delivered to the client as a traditional block-based hard disk interface via network is used to support back-compatibility and then enable client mobility and service. In this talk, I will start with the concept of transparent computing and then focus on the detailed designs of AVMM. Then, I will give some performance evaluation of our implemented prototype, and compare it with other similar approaches.

articleTitle: 3D reconstruction of secretory cavity in citrus fruit
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: Secretory cavity is not only a common protecting structure in Citrus, but also a primary site of the synthesis, secretion, and collection of effective components. For the stereo microscopic structure of secretory cavity in Citrus, there still has been few reports. In this paper, all continuous sections of half Citrus fruit were achieved by paraffin slice. These sections were double stained with crocus-fast green. Through Zeiss Stemi 2000-c microscopic photographing and Adobe Photoshop CS3 image processing, a three dimensional structure of secretory cavities in semi-fruit was built by software platform Velocity 4. And the number of secretory cavities was counted by Ipwin51c. The purpose of the study was to find a quick way to determine the distribution and quantity of secretory cavities in Citrus fruits.

articleTitle: Combination application of outpatient informationization and the SAFE-CARE system improve the level of outpatient medical service
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: This article is to investigate the role of outpatient informationization and the SAFE-CARE system in raising the level of outpatient high-quality medical service. It summarizes combination application experiences of outpatient informationization and the SAFE-CARE system to improve the level of outpatient medical service during the past year. Outpatient informationization has provided an efficient operational tool to improve the treatment efficiency; the SAFE-CARE system has guaranteed medical safety and quality, and enhanced the level of hospital management. Therefore, the combination application of outpatient informationization and the SAFE-CARE system is one of important measures to alleviate the difficulties of the masses medical treatment.

articleTitle: Relationship between chimera and immunologic tolerance of living kidney transplantation from husband to wife based on the analysis of SPSS
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: Use SPSS factor analysis to investigate the long-term spouse life, to analysis microchimerism expression in peripheral blood after kidney transplantation, which can effectively improve the quality of clinical data processing, and carry out the development of immune tolerance correlation studies easily. Long time of living together enables the wife to receive passive immunization, due to possibilities of body fluid exchanges, and probably form immunologic tolerance. As a result, after operation, wives received living kidney transplantation from husband were better, so there were fewer possibilities of rejection, and the survival rates were higher.

articleTitle: The design of Teaching System Based on Bluetooth
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: This article describes a Teaching System Based on Bluetooth. And it has a brief introduction about the Bluetooth. The system consists of server terminal systems and client terminal systems. The server terminal systems mainly include student situation, question feedback, the test module, group discussions, data download module, which are controlled by teachers; Client terminal systems mainly include login server-side, browse server resources, answer questions, group discussions, submit the classroom or practice homework, evaluation of teaching. The system will be hoped to improve the limitations of traditional teaching and learning, and has a breakthrough in mobile learning in real-time and interactive, and it is designed to promote more effective teaching and learning, and provide new ideas for the classroom mobile education.

articleTitle: Research on college english language and literature professional teaching methods
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: Language and literature professional courses for colleges and universities of english teaching in accordance with culture of the needs of english educators set the basis for development of arts teaching in primary and secondary schools, is the key to deter mining the quality of arts education. In this paper, the Language and Literature english education, for example to explore the methods of the higher english education.

articleTitle: E-learning-oriented personalized multimedia resource management
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: The combination of E-learning and multimedia resources management can help digital assets be used rationally and managed effectively. Thematic study can strengthens the learners understanding of the learning content, helps learners to obtain overall and comprehensive knowledge, and mobilizes the learners' interest and enthusiasm of learning. Therefore, this paper introduces the description model of object-oriented media resources based on metadata. And we also design and implement an E-learning-oriented personalized multimedia resources management platform.

articleTitle: Design of temperature monitoring system for red wine fermentation based on ZigBee
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: In order to solve the complexity field wiring problems of traditional fermentation control system, and achieve the effective monitoring about fermentation process parameter in the wireless environment. This paper introduced a red wine fermentation process monitoring technology based on ZigBee. First, analysis the principle of temperature monitoring system based on ZigBee wireless network, then design the hardware structure and related software of each node of the system. Advanced a program of wireless temperature monitoring system based on ZigBee technology. Specific uses CC2430 chip and so on, to achieve automatic detection and control of the temperature about the red wine fermentation process. Research show that, the wireless network control structure of ZigBee is simple, and the communication is flexible and convenient. It can reduce investment and human capital in red wine fermentation production, and to complete revenue and optimization the fermentation process.

articleTitle: Point location in Voronoi diagrams of polygons
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: Given a query point and the Voronoi diagram of a polygon (VD(P)), how to efficiently find the Voronoi region (VR) containing the query point, i.e., the point location in VD(P), is a fundamental operation for many other algorithms based on VD(P), such as path planning, visibility, and so on. A triangulation refinement method for VD(P) is presented in this paper, and then a point-location data structure is provided so that the VR containing the query point can be reported in O(logn) time. The algorithm takes O(n) space and O(nlogn) preprocessing time.

articleTitle: Quick algorithm for finding the kth real data
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: This paper makes further research to the storage structure of the real data inside the computer and finds the contained rule. Based on this rule, it puts forward a quick algorithm of finding the kth data from real data sets. The time complexity of the algorithm is lower than traditional searching algorithm based on comparison. The added storage space is very small. The above conclusion is proved to be correct through the experiment at the end of this paper.

articleTitle: The new course recording method based on the teaching signature design for enhance students' learning motivation
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: Multimedia instruction is an effective way to help learners create meaningful knowledge and to make referential connections between mental representations. This study aims to provide a system for manufacturing high-quality digital courses in a more easy and convenient way, namely Signature Design system (SDS). Using the proposed SDS, the teacher can layout the components of a teaching screen with a variety type of media files, such as slide and video files and the built layout can be saved and reused for other courses. Meanwhile, with a media server, a recording course can be broadcasted through the internet intermediately to provide the option for synchronous learning. There are five main advantages of the proposed SDS. First, the courses recorded through the SDS do not need enormous post-processing. In addition, the recording course can be broadcasted on the internet intermediately. Second, a variety of media such as slide, word processor and video files can be integrated into a screen. Third, to capture the teacher's front face in a better view, the SDS allows more than two DVs and the DVs can be swapped smoothly by the hot swapping control function built in SDS. Fourth, the teacher can layout the desired screen of a course and, more importantly, the designed layout is reusable for next or another course. Fifth, the teacher can quickly change the different scenes and do not have to break recording. It can provide a variety of teaching scenes to allow students to learn like in real situation.

articleTitle: Research and Practice of university database Migration
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: We make an investigation into the approach and technique used in database Migration in this paper. Different database migrations such as Oracle, SqlServer are discussed. As an example, we design and implement a migration project for Tsinghua University. This project migrates Oracle RAC into a different platform completely and successfully. At the same time, it will shorten the switch time and minimize the influence.

articleTitle: The application of the E-learning and teaching in the periodontology
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: Application of internet and multimedia technologies on periodontology clinical teaching and learning is introduced. After digital processing, the simulated E-learning can help to supplement the deficiency of clinical education resources. The actual effect shows that education efficiency is improved evidently, and multi dimensional interaction and resources sharing are realized as well.

articleTitle: Research of university library knowledge service
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: This paper analyzes the concept and characteristics of the university library knowledge service, and points out the problems and obstacles in the process of university library knowledge service. At the end it carry out the recommendations by expanding the range, changing concepts, create a platform to improve the service in the future.

articleTitle: Innovation of management model of adult education in the information age
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: In the age of information, novel demands and challenges occurs in the management of adult education. Taking management model of adult education as a complex and holistic system, from the point of view of all participants in the system (including administrators, teachers, students, etc.), this paper studied on the innovation of education philosophy, training objectives, teaching model and student management through information technology in management model of adult education and proposed solutions to make it more in line with the educational needs in the information age.

articleTitle: The diagnostic value of two echocardiography methods for atrial septal aneurysm
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: To evaluate the diagnostic value and clinical significance of two echocardiography methods in detecting atrial septal aneurysm (ASA). 44 cases of ASA with normal carotid arteries were retrospectively analyzed. Characteristic of ASA was detected by Transthoracic echocdrdiography (TTE) and Transesophageal echocordioqraphy (TEE), including the width of basal part, maximal excursion or protrusion beyond the plane of the atrial septum, direction of protrusion, motion, thickness of wall, presence of thrombi attaching to the wall, atrial septal defect, outflow tract obstruction and other structural abnormalities associated with ASA. It was founded that ASA occurred in the oval fossa, and the vast majority of ASA stretch to the right atrium. 4 cases were complicated by atrial septal defect and 6 cases were patent foramen ovale. No significant differences were found with two methods in bulging height, width, and wall thickness of ASA between children, adolescent and adult. ASA's TEE diagnostic accuracy of 92.6%, while only 54.5% of TTE. The results suggest that two methods have reliable diagnostic value to ASA, can find with or without complications and provide valuable information for clinical diagnosis and treatment. TEE is more helpful to characterize different types of ASA and superior to TTE in the diagnostic accuracy to ASA.

articleTitle: Status quo and development on cross-domain authentication based on public key cryptosystems
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: Authentication is the most basic prerequisite for secure communications. Authentication theory and technology play a key role in the application of modern cryptography. Cross-domain authentication among entities of different management domains is an important subject. An in-depth study on this subject and related supporting theory has been made so far. This paper-outlines the status quo and trends of cross-domain authentication, including the study on the cross-domain authentication mechanism and the framework, the security models, the application protocols, key agreement protocols based on groups, key agreement protocols based on password, provable secure cross-domain signcryption and KEM/DEM key encapsulation. Furthermore, it points out problems which should be widely concerned in the future, and gives the view points for the trends of the research field.

articleTitle: Digital kidney for planning in laparoscopic partial nephrectomy
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: The aim of the study was to create an anatomical digital 3D model of the kidney for planning in laparoscopic partial nephrectomy. Based on computer tomography (CT) images, regions of interest were segmented and a virtual 3D reconstructed digital kidney model was created using the Mimics 10.01 software (Materialise, Leuven, Belgium). This patient-specific 3D model was used to plan the laparoscopic partial nephrectomy (LPN). The surgeon was able to identify risk structures, assess the ideal resection planes and predict the residual shape after a reconstructive procedure. In conclusion, the use of digital kidney may facilitate laparoscopic surgical procedure due to better planning and improved orientation.

articleTitle: The indicators and concept of self-determined learning platform
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: The purpose of this research is to establish the indicators of self-determined learning platform. The research has developed the indicators with three major concepts, and 41 indicators. The finding of the research shows of the research shows of the research shows definition of SDL, we emphasizing self-determination according to the degree that people have different motives in different types of regulation, in which basic needs into three a psychological need. Based on literature review, this study assume that SDL through the social context of interaction with peers and teachers. This study also applied the concept of SDL into online platforms and plans to detect student's e-decision thinking, and e-decision-making by SDL platform.

articleTitle: Protein structure analysis and molecular evolution of CD34 in Homo sapiens
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: CD34 is a kind of highly glycosylated type I transmembrane glycoprotein,selectively present on hematopoietic cells, endothelial progenitor cells, mast cells within the human body or other animals. It is related to the transportation and setting of the hematogenic stem cells, intercellular adhesion, the lymphocyte homing and some pathological phenomenons. The amino acid sequence of CD34 was obtained from NCBI and analyzed by using different bioinformatics software tools and Internet resources for better understanding of the expression and regulation of CD34. Based on some investigations we know that CD34 is a stable hydrophilic membrane protein and own a structure with transmembrane domain. The secondary structure is composed of alpha helix (23.12%), extended strand (16.62%) and random coil (60.26%). The molecular evolution analysis revealed that the 7 species were divided into two major branches. One is for Mus sp, Homo sapiens, Callithrix jacchus and the other is Capra hircus, Bos Taurus,Tursiops truncates, Felis catus. This phylogenetic tree is consistent well with recognized evolutionary relationship among these species. In this article the main focus will be on the physicochemical properties, structures and functions of CD34 in human and the evolutionary relationship with different organisms.

articleTitle: The design and implementation of exquisite course website
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: Based on the analysis and research on the exquisite course website, a more reasonable and practical solution of design and implementation is put forward. Breaking the fixed mode of the online testing subsystem in traditional exquisite course website realizes the dynamic and random questions extraction as well as the dynamic changes of the item options. At the same time teaching_video on demand using Nginx server to load balancing not only increases the number of concurrent connections, but also reduces the response delay of the end-users. In conclusion, the real-time distance education subsystem based on Red5 server provides a virtual classroom for communication between teachers and students while also promoting the development of internet-based higher education.

articleTitle: Teaching nursing English based on needs analysis in Chinese context: Problem-situated instruction for EOP in a non-English speaking country
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: The aim of conducting this study was to investigate the effectiveness of a problem-situated intervention in nursing English teaching after needs analysis which is always neglected by Chinese EOP instructors. The control group and the intervention group students were taught by problem-situated instruction and current Chinese standard EOP teaching respectively. The intervention group students acted better in both course examination and examination for nursing English abilities, especially in listening, speaking and reading abilities. Additionally, the higher evaluation for teaching quality was made by the intervention group students. It can be inferred that problem-situated intervention based on needs analysis helps to improve students' nursing English skills and instructors' teaching effects in Chinese nurse education context.

articleTitle: A template extraction approach for image recognition
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: A robust approach for extracting template from images with relatively poor quality is presented in this paper. The approach combines fast Fourier transformation algorithm and weighted normalized cross correlation algorithm to deal with images taken under weak template. Basically, it consists of three steps: 1) searching candidate template from the target image using prefabricated template, and 2) determining the count of template matching area and adjusting the candidate template by using neighborhood growth method, and 3) evaluating the optimal template among the candidate templates. A set of experiments has been performed and the results shows that the proposed approach can obtain templates accurately and robustly.

articleTitle: Reform of computer basics based on modular teaching
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: The paper analyzes various types of modules for course teaching of Computer Basics (CB) for students in different major fields. Based on the teaching modules, the idea for CB suitable for the students in different majors or personnel trainings is proposed. The modular teaching, n + x mode, in which some drawbacks might be encountered, is presented. For practical applications, the corresponding measures to address those problems are also put forward.

articleTitle: An adaptive video watermarking algorithm
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: An adaptive data hiding method is proposed that encapsulates forbidden zone data hiding in order to improve the robustness of watermark under the premise of ensuring the subjective quality of host video and the invisibility of watermark. The algorithm based on human visual masking characteristics calculates each block's variance and energy and then selects the range of forbidden zone and the embedding strength according to two above values. This method is tested with H.264/AVC compression and strong common signal processing attacks, such as Gaussian filtering, to compare with the original algorithm. The simulation results indicate that the proposed method is more robust against attacks such as noise and compression and can be successfully utilized in video data hiding applications.

articleTitle: Application of salivary protein fingerprint model in the syndrome differentiation of breast cancer
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: Objective: Using Surface enhanced laser desorption and ionization time-of-flight mass spectrometry (SELDI-TOF MS) analysis of the salivary proteins of breast cancer patients (liver qi stagnation syndrome and deficiency of both liver and kidney yin syndrome), and to determine specific protein marker and establish a salivary protein fingerprint for the differentiation of liver qi stagnation syndrome and deficiency of both liver and kidney yin syndrome in patients with breast cancer. Methods: Fourty-seven saliva samples from breast cancer patients (26 patients were of liver qi stagnation syndrome, 21 patients of deficiency of both live and kidney yin syndrome) were tested using SELDI-TOF-MS to establish diagnostic model of traditional Chinese medicine (TCM) for breast cancer. Results: In these 2 groups, 243 proteins peaks were identified and 33 protein peaks showed significantly statistical difference. A diagnostic model consisting of 2 proteins (mass to charge ratio (M/Z) value was 8087.575 Da and 3378.142 Da respectively) was established and could be used to distinguish liver qi stagnation syndrome and deficiency of both liver and kidney yin syndrome. In 47 breast cancer patients, 25 of liver qi stagnation syndrome were correctly diagnosed, and 21 of deficiency of both liver and kidney yin syndrome were correctly ruled out. The sensitivity is 96.15% (25/26), and specificity 80.95% (17/21). Conclusions: Using SELDI-TOF-MS technique to establish salivary protein fingerprint model for TCM syndrome differentiation of breast cancer can provide a novel method of high specificity and sensitivity for the differentiation of TCM syndromes, and further investigation and application should be performed.

articleTitle: The development of a flies species recognition system
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: Automation has become a good reason to various activities that involve a repetition, high labour cost and shortage of skilful person. When automation offers accuracy, faster and replicable, a routine recognition process which will distract the workforce can be reduced. We developed an automated flies species recognition system using hybrid Artificial Intelligent technique specifically for Maggot Debridement Therapy. Currently, the process of recognition was done manually by referring to the taxonomy or DNA traits. By using such system, the use of incorrect maggot can be avoided since it would consume a live tissue instead of dead tissue. This paper focus on a research methodology description which consists of empirical study, architecture design and development of flies species recognition system.

articleTitle: Oleanolic acid on SAMP8 mice in vivo experimental intervention study
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: Objective: To study the application of Chinese herbs (Ligustrum lucidum) monomer oleanolic acid on Alzheimer's disease (AD) model mice cognitive learning ability, and E2 in vivo, Ach, TSH, interferon levels, and to explore the relationship among them. Methods:18 24-week-old mice (rapidly aging SMP8) were randomly divided into oleanolic acid group, the placebo group and SMP8 control group, and the other 6 selected mice as a homologous normal aging SAMR1 control group, the use of irrigation stomach after 4 weeks of drug intervention methods for water maze test(Morris maze) and biochemical testing of serum E2, Ach, TSH, IFN-concentration changes. Results: Oleanolic acid can effectively improve the Cognitive learning ability of the SMP8 mice, and impact the levels of E2, Ach, TSH, interferon (P <0.05). Conclusion: Oleanolic acid can be adjusted SAMP8 mice E2, Ach, TSH, interferon levels, and improve Alzheimer's mice cognitive learning ability, to achieve the prevention and treatment of senile dementia of the results.

articleTitle: Preparation and antioxidant characters of selenium-containing soybean peptide with glutathione peroxidase activity
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: The two soybean peptides (SP), SP-1 and SP-2, were obtained after hydrolyzing the Soybean Isolated Protein (SIP) by alcalase protease. And then, the SPs were converted into selenium-containing SPs (Se-SP) by chemically modification. The Se-SPs showed higher GPX activity than Ebselen, the first mimic of GPX, but they were much lower than native GPX. The characters of Se-SPs were also determined such as the selenium content, binding constant of active for GSH. In addition, antioxidant activity experiment indicated that Se-SPs has potential application. The Se-SPs possessed high scavenging ability to super-oxide anion, and they can protect mitochondria against oxidative damage with ferrous sulfate/ascorbate-(Fe<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2+</sup>/Vc) induced mitochondria damage model. This not only increases the practical value of SPs, but also increased value-added products to market was provided.

articleTitle: Using iTRAQ quantitative proteomics to identify differentially expressed proteins in saliva from breast cancer patients with white tongue coating and yellow tongue coating
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: Objective: To screen out the differentially expressed proteins in saliva from breast cancer patients with white tongue coating and yellow tongue coating and subjects from healthy control group in order to find a biomarker for the early diagnosis of breast cancer and explore the mechanism and principle behind the formation of the tongue coating in traditional Chinese medicine (TCM). Methods: Breast cancer patients with thick white tongue coating and thick yellow tongue coating were enrolled, 10 patients for each group, and 10 normal individuals with thin white tongue coating were also enrolled. Proteins were extracted from the serum of the subjects, underwent denaturation, reduction and enzymolysis, labeled by isobaric tags for relative and absolute quantitation (iTRAQ) and identified by ESI-QTOF-Q II mass spectrometer. Peak spectrum were obtained, and analyzed by Data Analysis, MASCOTT 2.2 Searching and Scaffold. Then the results of differential expression were obtained. Results: There were 464 proteins identified, and 125 proteins met the strict quantitative criteria. Compared with heath control, 11 differentially expressed proteins were selected for breast cancer patients, with white tongue coating and yellow coating, while 26 differentially expressed proteins were selected between breast cancer with white tongue coating and yellow tongue coating. Conclusions: iTRAQ combined with liquid chromatography linked to tandem mass spectrometry (LC-MS/MS) analysis could swiftly and effectively perform proteomics study on differentially expressed proteins in saliva. And certain proteins closely connected with the occurrence of breast cancer and mechanism behind formation of tongue coating of TCM were also discovered.

articleTitle: The Measurement of foreign students'ability of writing in Chinese with a Many-Facets Rasch model
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: The study employed Many-Facets Rasch Model (MFRM) to validate writing assessment for foreign students learning Chinese. Three raters and 40 foreign university students were involved in the study and four categories of the rating scale were employed to score the compositions of these students. Results show that the rating scale was able to distinguish between different levels of ability of writing in Chinese of the examinees, there were significant differences in their ability of writing in Chinese and that raters used the scale in a consistent and consensus way.

articleTitle: Research on video monitor data management of college entrance examination
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: The characteristics of video monitoring network system is applied in entrance examination video monitoring, and video monitoring data management system which based on the college entrance examination is designed. Introduces the implementation process of system,in application of the system architecture,multiple points backup strategy is put forward. To solve the problem of single-point failure under the multilevel monitoring and improve the robustness of the system,adopt the mothod of uploaded the directed backups and random backups to upper monitor by the bottom server separately. Finally, improved RSVP protocol which based on the system is proposed, which guarantees special video application requirements in real time with end-to-end multi-state reservation.

articleTitle: On the Personal e-Learning System
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: E-learning is a main approach of learning in the network environment. This article focuses on the Personal e-Learning System (PLS). The definition of the Personal e-Learning System is provided, and the essential elements of a Personal e-Learning System are analyzed. The features, functions and the mechanism of the Personal e-Learning System (PLS) are outlined and discussed. The authors believe that the Personal e-Learning System is essential and helpful for learners.

articleTitle: Teaching academic writing to medical professionals using computer communication media
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: Academic writing is an important skill of those medical professionals who wish to engage in education and research. In addition, many medical professionals whose first language is not English need to learn academic writing in English because it is the dominant language in academic communications. At most universities in Taiwan, however, academic writing is not included in the undergraduate curriculum, and therefore most of the medical professionals began to learn academic writing after starting their careers. Medical professionals usually have busy schedules and need to do shift work, but learning to write in a second language is time consuming and needs a lot of practice. Whereas learners can benefit from proof reading of the instructor, they can benefit even more if the instructor can guide them through the proof reading process and explain the reasons for corrections. This study applied one of the most popular computer communication media, which has a desktop sharing function, to the teaching of academic writing and asked students report their experience. In comparison with face-to-face one-on-one teaching, students reported advantages including flexibilities in schedule and place, saving of traffic time, potential to broadcast to other students, no need for a classroom or office, and the option of making a recording for replaying and sharing with other students. On the other hand, students reported limitations including the needs of equipment and access to network, interruptions of the connection, and bad quality of communication sometimes. Overall, medical professionals prefer this learning mode than face-to-face one-on-one learning.

articleTitle: An empirical analysis of the impact of FDI on China's pharmaceutical intra- industry trade
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: What role has FDI on China's foreign trade competitiveness? This problem is always the hot research point. How did FDI affect Chinese medicine industry? This paper studied China pharmaceutical intra-industry trade status, and the inter and intra-industry influence of FDI are distinguished, based on dynamic panel data model to carry out GMM estimation, obtained the conclusions that FDI spillover is significant, but mainly between industries. Investigating its reason, the article put forward the suggestion of strengthening the R & D investment, improving personnel quality, etc.

articleTitle: Cloud computing application in health vocational education
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: Facing the current inadequacy of informatization in health vocational education, this paper focuses on setting up a cloud-computing-based model for health vocational education, designing to use cloud computing reliable and secure data storage, convenient web services and strong capability of calculation. It will have positive effect on health vocational education informatization in China.

articleTitle: Reengineering high-cost medical consumables management by Tianjian system
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: Objective To establish a precise management process of medical consumables. Methods Based on a standardized sharing dictionary, we link processes chain of every departments, and can connect patient's information to consumable information by sticking a single code label to a high-cost consumable. Results We insure that every high-cost medical consumables would be inspected, and would be traced or recalled in 30 minutes. Conclusion We use contemporary information technology and management process to master accurate tracks of every high-cost medical consumables.

articleTitle: Study on excessive balances risk of new rural cooperative medical fund
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: We analyzed the risk of basic medical insurance fund excessive balances in China's new rural cooperative medical system, and found out the basic reasons of it. Finally, we give some suggestions to Medicare System for optimizing the fund balances and enhancing the operating efficiency of the Fund.

articleTitle: Research and practice of an open research innovation mode
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: Digital media technology is an intersection field of art and technology, which needs the inter-disciplinary talents who are good at art and computer technology and emphasis on the training of creative talents. Based on the analysis of existing problems in the traditional education mode and current practice teaching system, this paper puts forward an open research innovation mode — innovation works, which is able to make experiment teaching connect more smoothly with graduation project and to build a multidimensional practical teaching system whose practice activities are linked to each other more closely and to foster and exercise students' practical abilities in various ways and levels for enhancing their innovative abilities.

articleTitle: Application of virtual reality technology in the space teaching of Landscape Architecture
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: This paper focuses on the characteristics of the contents, methods and means of landscape architecture space teaching, combined with the background, puts forwards that the virtual reality technology, as a means of interactive, immersive and ideal information technology, promoted the development of basic space teaching of the landscape architecture, changed the drawbacks of the traditional landscape architecture space teaching, and optimized the teaching effects of in the courses of basic knowledge learning, exploring learning and experimental training, improved the student's learning interest on the basic courses.

articleTitle: Famous and old Chinese medicine prescription information collection based on the access database
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: This article uses the Access database as the basis, discussed the traditional Chinese medicine prescription in the Access database using form in store way. It provides convenient for using data mining analysis method of clinical medical record from refining old doctor of traditional Chinese medicine experience. To a large sample of clinical medical record carries out standard arrangement. The basic information of medical record, traditional Chinese and western medicine diagnosis, the four diagnostic information, laboratory checking, disease pathology, therapies and prescription carries out standardization, informationization, structured. The Access database is relatively independent. It has storage, analysis, display, print and other functions, and it is suitable for the traditional Chinese medicine prescription storage and data analysis. This paper discussed the Access as the advantages of information collection tool for the prescription, and put forward the shortcomings and thinking in setting up the process of old doctor of traditional Chinese medicine medical record. It opens up new ideas and methods for better in the future to inherit and carry forward old doctor of traditional Chinese medicine clinical experience and academic ideas.

articleTitle: Historical views navigation though similarity and closeness centrality based recommendation
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: when faculty in university visualize the students' personal information, they usually focus on the current view, losing trace of the historical views, which results in missing of some important information or patterns. To address this problem and figure out the unknowns hidden in educational datasets, this paper proposes the historical views navigation though similarity and closeness centrality based recommendation. In this approach, the useful intermediate views or the views interested by users are saved as history and compared with the current view. By analyzing the similarity between them and the closeness centrality measure, the most relative historical views are recommended to the user. Finally, the user study shows that most of the participants are interested in our work. They think it's helpful and will continue to use it.

articleTitle: Pharmacokinetics of florfenicol in Japanese eel (Anguilla japonica) after a single oral dose
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: Florfenicol has been approved to specially used in livestock and aquatic animals including eels. The present study provides a better understanding of florfenicol deposition in Japanese eel (Anguilla japonica) following oral administration of a single dose of 30 mg/kg at 25 °C. The pharmacokinetics parameters were calculated by both noncompartmental and compartmental operations using DAS software. The plot of florfenical concentration-time in plasma after oral dose is fitted by a two-compartment open model. In noncompartmental analysis, kinetics parameters of maximum concentration (C<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">max</inf>), time to C<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">max</inf> (T<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">max</inf>), mean residence time (MRT), half-life of drug (t<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1/2</inf>), volume of distribution (Vd) and clearance (CL) were calculated to be 15.920 µg/ml, 4 h, 18.370 h, 12.341 h, 2.078 L/kg and 0.117 L/kg/h, respectively. Based on the pharmacokinetic profiles provided in this study and the investigation of minimum inhibitory concentration (MIC) against the infectious bacteria reported previously, it is proposed that two dose of 30 mg/kg one day would be acceptable for treatment of eel with bacterial infections.

articleTitle: Pulse graph characteristics analysis and classification of sub health state
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: Objective: To study on sub health state pulse graph classification characteristics and data mining classification method. Method: 1275 cases were divided into health and sub-health groups through health assessment by “health assessment questionnaire”(H20.V2009), another 121 disease cases in the control group; classifying the sub-health pulse graph characteristics by using naïve Bayes, support vector machine, decision tree, neural network data mining algorithm methods according to the pulse diagram parameter evaluation. Result: Decision tree algorithm total classification results on health pulse graph for62%, on sub health pulse graph total classification results for81.1%, on disease pulse graph total classification result is 49.1%, the decision tree algorithm of pulse graph total classification results for the 72%, better than the other algorithms. Decision tree algorithm is more suitable for different health states of the pulse index classification research. Conclusion: Decision tree algorithm was the effect optimal method in data mining on health, sub-health, disease pulse graph classification, data mining method facilitated the classification of pulse graph health, sub health and disease.

articleTitle: A corpus voice-based study of expressions of agreement in Chinese university textbooks
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: This paper is a corpus-based study comparing the expressions of agreement in English textbooks and in authentic English in order to improve the authenticity and practicality of the English textbooks used in China with the help of the corpus Voice. The paper intends to study and analyze the similarities and differences of expressions of agreement found in China's textbooks and in corpus Voice. The results from the quantitative and qualitative analyses reveal that there are significant differences between English textbooks and authentic English in expressing agreement.

articleTitle: A study on China's teaching method in college education
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: With the continuing upgrading of the economic globalization, cooperation and exchanges among countries are becoming more frequent. China's college graduates are facing unprecedented competition from graduates all over the world, China's college education is facing new challenges. This paper demonstrates the importance for China's colleges and universities to improve educational informationalization and bilingual education, and then proceeds to put forward a number of ideas and suggestions.

articleTitle: Identification of gallicin from Myricaria laxiflora and its antibiotic & antioxidant activity
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: Myricaria Laxiflora is a rare and endangered riparian shrub in Three Gorges zone, China. Locally, the plants are widely used as a traditional herbal medicine for scald and arthritis, but the pharmacological activity has not been elucidated, and the mechanism was far from clear. In order to explore the possible pharmacological mechanism, 6 compounds were extracted here by chloroform in the 95% ethanol precipitation under different pH value. After investigation of the antimicrobial activity in vitro through eight microorganisms, we found the compounds in different pH condition showed specific inhibitory activity to bacteria and fungus. In pH=7 extract, we isolated a gallic acid derivant named methyl 3-hydroxy-4,5-dimethoxybenzoate (gallicin) by 1D, 2D NMR and MS identification, and this compound showed obvious antimicrobial activities. The minimum inhibitory concentration of this compound was 5 mg/ml against Staphylococcus aureus and Rhizopus, and 10 mg/ml against E. coli. Furthermore, just like propyl gallate, gallicin showed fairly active for oxidation resistance in the presence of H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>.

articleTitle: Modeling and evoluting of relation between acupuncture points and diseases based on multi-dimension networks
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: In this paper, we establish a model to describe the relationship between acupuncture points and diseases and we study its evolution based on multi-dimension networks. Firstly, we build a multi-dimension network called acupoint-disease network by using data from traditional Chinese medicine acupuncture books. Secondly, we reduce the network dimension to form a disease-based acupoint network and an acupoint-based disease network respectively. The static characteristics of these two networks, which include clustering coefficient, average path length and small-world character etc, are analyzed. Thirdly, we put forward a network evolution model and its algorithms. Finally, we compare the analyzed results above with the traditional Chinese medicine theory, which indicates that the results totally conform to traditional Chinese medicine theory.

articleTitle: A study on construction of 7-class electronic medical records system
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: This paper firstly discusses the significance of the construction of 7-level electronic medical records and points out that the key is the standardization and paperless of electronic medical records. Secondly,the paper puts forwards the problems to be solved in the construction of electronic medical records, such as the standardization, legal orientation, safety of electronic signature, credible time stamp, selection of organizations of digital certificate and management conception. Finally, it analyzes the solutions to the above-mentioned problems. In order to realize the standardization and paperless of electronic medical records, we should make the construction according to the standards of Ministry of Health, improve legislation, choose the right organizations of digital authentication and time stamp, develop management system of signature, renew our conception, integrate data, adopt the consultation system, effect paperless storage, make wireless treatment, set up urgent prearrangement and so on.

articleTitle: Speech based boredom verification approach for modern education system
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: Owing to the emotion deficiency problem in many of the conventional education systems, emotion sensing has become a new recent research trend as it is possible to provide useful strategies to enhance the learning effectiveness of a student. Among the various modalities for emotion sensing, this paper a speech-based emotion verification system. In particular, boredom verification is addressed herein. We present an emotion feature set comprising mel-frequency cepstral coefficients (MFCCs), Legendre-based trend coefficients (LBTCs) of MFCCs and 4th subband power, PCA transformed LBTCs, spectral flatness, and RSS. The proposed feature set is fed into a 2-class support vector machine (SVM) for boredom emotion verification. The proposed system has been demonstrated an emotional speech database with a 67.79% verification rate.

articleTitle: Study on NcRNAs related to Cancer using Z-curve method
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: It is accepted that non-coding RNAs (ncRNAs) play very important roles in the cellular process of translation and relates to Human Severe Diseases. In this work, 14 disease-related ncRNA sequences are selected from the NONCODE database. These different ncRNAs play regulator or constituent roles and relate to Cancer. In this work, we map and analyze the Z curves of the selected sequences using Z-curve method. Then we compare the curves and calculate the base content, respectively. We can see that there are almost same curves and base content for one kind of ncRNAs playing same roles. Meanwhile, there are obviously differences in some curves of ncRNA sequences having different functions and coming from different organisms. The conclusion is that the feature of Z-curves is a criterion to recognize ncRNAs and the Z-curve is connected with the function and organisms.

articleTitle: Reasearch on the trampoline athletes' femur anatomise structure
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: Objective. Exploring the difference of the femur anatomise structure between the trampoline athletes and the normals, evaluating the impact of the trampoline training. Methods. 16 trampoline athletes in Jiangsu are divided to two experiment groups, youth group and junior group, shoot pelvic flat X-ray photography, measure the parameters on each flat X-ray photography, like femoral head diameter, neck shaft angle, length of femoral neck, length of femoral offset, metaphyseal width T0,T+20,T−20, CE angle, AC angle, pitch angle, pelvic height, pelvic width, HT. Then compare with proximal femoral anatomical parameters of normal people. Results. Trampoline athletes and normal have some differences in proximal femoral anatomical parameters, especially different in CE angle, AC angle, femoral head diameter, length of femoral neck, neck shaft angle, length of femoral offset, metaphyseal width T0,T+20,T−20. Conclusions. Trampoline athletes devote to long-term trampoline training, making big differences with proximal femoral anatomical parameters of normal people.

articleTitle: Feasibility and strategy analysis for library knowledge service based on knowledge management
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: This paper combines the current theory research and practice on knowledge management and library knowledge service, introduces the definition and the characteristic of library knowledge service, analyzes the feasibility and strategy for library knowledge service based on knowledge management. Finally, according to the research, the thesis put some feasibility suggestion and put forward through building the information resource sharing system to improve library knowledge service.

articleTitle: The research on information filtering model based on immune self-learning mechanism
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: We designed a kind of new information filtering model based on biological immune system. In this model, the original information is as antigen, and the strategy of filtering and procedure is as antibody. Antibody could learn and evolve continuously. The model has abilities of learning, storage and evolution, and it could learn and synergy automatically, adjust services, to complete complicated tasks with high efficiency. At last, the simulation experiment proved that the model has high efficiency and accuracy.

articleTitle: Research on risk control system ITG-HRCM in IT governance
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: In this paper, based on the preliminary research results K-PRS-ISMCS and PRS-ISMCS, a variety of risks existed in the process of IT governance are firstly analyzed; then a full-life cycle, multi-layered structure of IT risk governance ITG-HRCM (Hierarchical risk control model) integrated with ERMF and COBIT based on PRS-ISMCS is put forward with the description of the model function; thirdly a kind of improved risk quantization and calculation method is described; finally the work of experimental simulation is done to various risks in the process of IT governance, which proves that ITG-HRCM with its improved risk quantitative calculation method can meet the demand and expectations of information security objectives in IT governance.

articleTitle: A study of diagnostic model for serum protein finger-print of thyroid cancer patients based on SELDI technique
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: Objective: To establish a diagnostic model for serum protein finger-print of thyroid cancer patients. Methods: serum samples of 40 patient with thyroid cancer and 30 healthy subjects were tested by surface enhanced laser desorption/ionization time-of-flight mass spectrometry (SELDI-TOF MS). Protein finger-print was obtained, and 2 specific differentially expressed proteins were selected. A diagnostic model was established with the help of bioinformatics. Results: By comparing the data of differentially expressed proteins from 2 groups, and 121 protein peaks were obtained within the range 2000Da - 20000Da. Eighteen protein peaks showed significant difference in 2 groups ( P < 0.01), 5 protein peaks with mass to charge (M/Z) value 2050.69, 2940.50, 3942.92, 5345.54 and 6918.33 were selected by the Biomarker Pattern Software to construct decision-tree classification diagnostic model for serum differentially expressed proteins. In the test group of this model, the accuracy was 81.4% (57/70), sensitivity 80.0 (32/40), and specificity 83.3% (25/30). Conclusions: the model for serum protein finger-print is able to achieve the optimal effects distinguishing the thyroid cancer patient and healthy individuals. SELDI technology is a quick and effective tool in the diagnosis of thyroid cancer and screening of specific tumor marker.

Author Keywords: surface enhanced laser desorption/ionization time-of-flight mass spectrometry (SELDI-TOF-MS)

articleTitle: Effect of LongChai decoction-containing serum on the secretion of HBsAg, HBeAg and cell cycle in HepG2.2.15 Cells
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: Objective: To observe the effect of LongChai decoction-containing serum (LCD-CS) on the secretion of HBsAg, HBeAg and cell cycle in HepG2.2.15 cells. Methods: MIT assay was used to detect the viability of HepG2.2.15 cells after treatment of LCD-CS for 48 h. The content of HBsAg and HBeAg in HepG2.2.15 cell culture supernatant treated with LCD-CS for 48 h or 96 h was detected by ELISA. Effect of LCD-CS on cell cycle of HepG2.2.15 cells for 48 h was analyzed by flow cytometry. Results: LCD-CS could cause the morphological changes of HepG2.2.15 cells and exert significantly antiproliferative effects; The cell viability of LCD-CS decreased significantly compared with the blank serum group (*P<;0.05, **P<;0.01); LCD-CS significantly inhibited the secretion of HBsAg and HBeAg, compared with the blank serum group(* P<;0.05, ** P<;0.01); LCD-CS made cell cycle arrest at the GO/G1 phase, and blocked cell proliferation. Conclusion: LCD-CS had effect of anti-HBV in vitro.

articleTitle: The impact of IT on job qualifications for librarians in the digital age and implications for LIS education
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: Libraries are facing many challenges by ICT and digital revolution. The role of library professionals is also changing: they act as cybrarian instead of librarians. Librarians are playing integrated roles beyond their traditional jobs. In this paper, we discuss the impact of IT on requirements for librarian jobs in the digital age by analyze librarian employment ads to reveal: What are educational backgrounds required or librarian positions? What are the most common job titles for librarian positions? What implication will outcome of this study provide for LIS education in China? The analysis of librarian employment advertisements will be valuable to library educators in understanding current and emerging staffing patterns and designing effective curricula in China.

articleTitle: Research and application of collision problem in flexible fabrics simulation
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: In the process of flexible fabric simulation, collision detection algorithm is directly related to the simulation efficiency and accuracy. In the paper, we use Fixed Direction Hull (FDH) to solve the problem of collisions, and use the hierarchical region segmentation and human model simplification to reduce the number of collisions. So the real-time simulation of flexible fabric comes true. At the end of the article, we give the results of the simulation experiment.

articleTitle: On the constructionist's teaching methods and class architects of securities investment
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: Traditional teaching methods and modern multimedia teaching methods have their own advantages and disadvantages, thus constructionist's teaching methods combine the two together. We firstly review the constructionist's teaching methods, and then we discuss how to use these methods into the Security Investments' teaching basing on our teaching experience. And we do the teaching experiment using IT as the auxiliary tool.

articleTitle: Research of track calculation of cooperative navigation system in sea environment
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: In this article, we employ GPS, inertial navigation, and radio navigation in a integrated navigation system. We establish a navigation simulation model and a vessel movement model to calculate navigation data. In this way, we solve the problems of track calculation and movement extrapolation.

articleTitle: Research on the establishment and application of electronic health record for residents in Zhenjiang City
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: This study selects Zhenjiang city as a sample area and examines the establishment and application status of the electronic health record for residents through the field survey to part of community health care centers and community residents. The existing problems are analyzed and as countermeasures, promoting community resident awareness of electronic health record by reinforcing propaganda, developing high-quality community general practitioners and increasing government financial investment are given out.

articleTitle: The exploration of the design patterns of Electronic Guidance Case based on web
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: This Electronic Guidance Case(EGC) is a design patterns of Guidance Case based on web, under this mode, the teachers control the state of student learning instantaneously and can make the corresponding “teaching” contents, the methods of choice and change, while they can also make full and effective use of the factors of educational resources, including the factors of the students themselves, the scenes of the design task, knowledge links and other learning support services, so that their ability of thinking and innovating will be developed well in the group cooperation and self-exploration activities.
