Through the literature and theoretical study methods, put forward the necessity of researching EGC, and compared to traditional design patterns of plan, illustrate the theoretical basis of the design patterns of EGC electronics modules of the plan; build up basic processes and process model of EGC. Asynchronous learning respect for individual learning differences and realize independent learning, all of which profoundly incarnate the concept of student-centered Education.

articleTitle: Identification of epitopes in Echinococcosis multilocularis 14-3-3 antigen: A bioinformatics approach
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: Em14-3-3 protein is reported as the important antigen in the immunology of Echinococcosis multilocularis. The sequence of Em14-3-3(Accession No: AF529419) from NCBI databank has been taken for this study. Computer-based prediction program results show that the B cell epitopes in the alleles of: 11–34,38–53,61–70,74–84,91–100,114–122,134–158,189–224, 229–244. The different structural features of the protein have also been predicted including glycosylation, kinase C phosphorylation, casein kinase II phosphorylation and N-myristylation sites. These computational prediction programs show four glycosylation, five kinase C phosphorylation, two casein kinase II phosphorylation, zero N-myristylation sites and seven disulphide sites. Development and approval of new vaccines are the keys for control of AE.

articleTitle: Learner's state analysis model using rough set theory in e-learning
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: Paper proposes an approach of e-learning system for mining the learner's state. The learner's state means the degree of enthusiasm of the students. E-learning system must not only have complete knowledge Structure and should also be intelligent to analyze the state of the learner to facilitate guide and motivate. Rough set theory is a powerful tool for extracting rules. Based on time parameters, this paper proposes the rules mining process and methods of learner's state using rough set theory.

articleTitle: Construction of individualized assessment system for Traditional Chinese Medicine therapeutic effects evaluation
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: Deficiency and independency of the existing supporting data, intervention variability and lucking of consistence led to it difficult to assess the therapeutic effect of Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) individually. The study of this work mainly focuses on three aspects to help resolving the difficulty of TCM individual assessment. First, an information platform is established, which will be data-sharing and medical experts involved, by networks and database technology so as to provide data samples for individualized assessment. Second, based on massive data and string matching algorithms provided by the information platform, an indicator database with relative assessment standard is constructed. With the following accumulation and modification, indicator database can generate indicator tree dynamically to satisfy “common” and “personality” requirements for individualized assessment. Third, the dynamic and comprehensive assessment of TCM efficiency is achieved by processing the qualitative and quantitative indicator with a dimensionless representative. The efficacy of TCM individual evaluation information platform is evaluated based on individualized diagnosis, Syndrome Differentiation and Treatment.

articleTitle: Problems and countermeasures of production practice of speciality of pharmaceutical engineering in China
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: Pharmaceutical engineering is a newly emerging interdisciplinary major in China. As a part of practice education of pharmaceutical engineering, production practice plays an important role in consolidating undergraduate's knowledge, cultivating their specialty interests and increasing their innovative ability. This paper focuses on analysis of problems in production practice of this major under the new situation in China. Moreover, it provides countermeasures based on author's experience in order to deepen innovation of practice education and improve education quality and engineering practice.

articleTitle: Creating effective collaborative learning in a CALL environment
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: In the digital age, learning is no longer confined to face-to-face interaction. Effective learners should have the capacity to learn from various sources of knowledge through interaction. Considering the inefficiency of college English teaching in large classes in China, this paper aims at expounding how to create an effective collaborative English learning environment on the CALL platform for college students in terms of face-to-face interaction in class and online interaction after class.

articleTitle: Multidetector CT with 3D reconstruction for evaluation of diagnose and treatment in calcaneal fractures
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: Calcaneal fractures are the most common fractures of the tarsal bones, representing 2% of all fractures and accounting for 60%-65% of all tarsal fractures. Although conventional radiography is the first choice for diagnosis of calcaneal fractures, it can not distinguish accurately intra-articular fractures from microfractures. Two-dimensional multiplanar reformation (MPR) of the CT allows accurate evaluation of fracture lines, dislocation and comminution, but it cannot provide a global depiction. The three-dimensional reconstruction techniques can compensate the lack of conventional radiography and MPR imaging: it can not only display three-dimensional form of the lesions, but also observe the fractures not displayed in cross-sectional images.

articleTitle: Rule-based text mining of traditional Chinese medicine patterns with Chinese herbal medicines and symptoms on cirrhosis
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: Through several thousands years of clinical research and theoretical thoughts, traditional Chinese medicine (TCM) has accumulated rich experiences on cirrhosis. However, the usage of Chinese herbal medicines in formulae are flexible in TCM clinical practice according to pattern differentiation. So, it is important to get the composition rules of Chinese herbal medicines through literatures. Based on the keyword list of Chinese herbal medicine, pattern, and symptoms, through the keyword filtering skill, we got the lists of Chinese herbal medicines. However, for Chinese herbal medicines, they are not only mentioned in the plain format of herb names, but also densely described in the form of formulae (also called Chu-Fang, Yao-Fang or Tang-Yao in Chinese). As formulae are composed by Chinese herbal medicines according the theory of traditional Chinese medicine, so, it is necessary to filtering them out and de-compose them back into specified Chinese herbal medicines. In this study, take cirrhosis for example, we explored the composition-rules of Chinese herbal medicines and the network of TCM pattern with them. By doing this, we might get a deeper understanding of composition-rules of Chinese herbal medicines in clinical practice which might be a better reference for both clinical practise and medical research.

articleTitle: A multi-sensor information fusion method for otologic drill operating state estimation based on physical model and adaptive filter
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: A multi-sensor information fusion method for otologic drill operating state estimation is presented in this paper. It is composed of physical model and adaptive filter. Redundant information in the sensor signals can be eliminated by physical model, which is established according to the mechanism of otologic drill. The model could show the internal relation between sensor signals and compress them to characteristic curve. The interferences caused by modeling error and signal processing can be suppressed by the adaptive filter. By fusing sensor information further, the filter could eliminate interferences in the characteristic curve and reserve useful information. This fusion method has been used to estimate otologic drill operating state, and the milling fault of drilling through the bone tissue wall in the operation can be identified with rate of 90%.

articleTitle: On relationship among art university students' self-directed learning readiness, learning satisfaction and performance
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: This study investigates and interviews with students in art universities of six provinces in China by Behavioral Events Interview(BEI) and Focus Group Interview(FGI) and compiles related questionnaires. 500 valid questionnaires are taken back. The relationship among self-directed learning readiness, learning satisfaction and learning performance is obtained by factor analysis, correlation analysis and regression analysis. The following results are obtained: art university students' self-directed learning readiness and learning satisfaction have significant effects on their learning performance; the interactions between different self-directed learning readiness and learning satisfaction have relatively significant influence on learning performance.

articleTitle: Primary designed database of atherosclerosis-related gene and protein
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: We build atherosclerosis related gene and protein databases in order to promote atherosclerosis bioinformatics research. The gene and protein information were from databases such as GenBank, Pubmed, OMIM. After related search, we identified 180 atherosclerosis-related genes and 153 proteins which related-information were stored in the database. We designed database software to manage and query information. Through the integration of existing information, we established a secondary database to provide a new convenient bioinformatics query tool for basic research of atherosclerosis.

articleTitle: A signcryption scheme with Message Link Recovery
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: For large amount of computation in elliptic curve cryptography, we combined with Message Linkage Recovery Based on Elliptic Curve and proposed a new signcryption scheme with message link recovery by signcryption equation as the breakthrough point. The signcryption equation of the new scheme was s=k-r-kA mod n and the corresponding verification was X=(s+r)G+PA, which correctness has been verified. The results of analyzed the efficiency of operation and the security of the improved scheme show that, it meets the safety requirements of digital signature scheme, at the same time, it reduces an operation of number multiplication in the process of signature and lowers the number of points multiplication. After, the new scheme was applied to the electronic evidence protection, which has the function of message recovery.

articleTitle: The application and thoughts on the multimedia teaching in bridge course of medical education
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: With an aim to improve teaching quality of medical bridging curriculum, facilitate Tibetan medical education reform, and promote the quality of talents, we have carried out course feature specific multimedia teaching in bridging medical curriculum and have studied noteworthy problems, which popped up in teaching, in combination with live cases of Tibetan higher education as well.

articleTitle: Study on library's competitive intelligence service of sport college
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: Competitive intelligence service is the extension and development of the basic functions of digital library. This paper explores the advantages of library Information service which carried out by colleges starting from the analysis of sport colleges' demand for competitive intelligence service. At the same time, it proposes a path to achieve this service of colleges.

articleTitle: Heuristic algorithm for multi-vehicle ride matching problem
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: Multi-vehicle ride matching problem studies how to take passengers as much as possible through optimizing vehicles' route and matching between vehicles and passengers. But at present, problems exist in the researches like that models divorced from reality and low efficiency of algorithms. For this problem, this paper presents a solution based on clustering of vehicles' route order. Transferring the MRMP to RMP through clustering of vehicles' route order, it forms the first matching result between vehicles and passengers. And looking for the best sort order through sorting the first matching result making use of priori clustering. At last, we optimize the solution one times more through optimized rules. Experimental result shows that, the method based on clustering of vehicles' route order can solve the problem with high matching efficiency and low cost.

articleTitle: Study on event correlation analysis in evidence chain structure
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: Computer forensics has limitations in representation formalism of the electronic evidence and data missing. A method in construction of electronic evidence chain was proposed on the basis of the study and analysis of event correlation, and it makes use of Bayesian network inference algorithm, which analysis of causal relationship of the events to deal with the missing data. This method to consider the interaction between evidence events and sequence relationship, it realizes formalization of the electronic evidence and reduces data redundancy in evidence analysis, which strengthens the pertinence of data process and evidence analysis, forensics system becomes more perfect.

articleTitle: Year 2020: Symbiotic computing towards post-modern information systems
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: Economic super cycles also known as "Kondratiev waves" closely related to the innovation of new technologies and its wide spread applications. If we follow the time span of this cycle, the next peak is expected to arrive around 2020. With the advancement of computer and communication technologies, a transformation from the current information society to a new society can be perceived which we named as "Symbiosis Society." As it is always observed that the invention of new technologies has made a huge impact on our life-style and society. Industrial revolution brings the modern era and the rationality, which consists of higher efficiency, better economy and improved functionality. But in search for a better and convenient life we forget to take care of the universe and its environment. A prime example is the undeniable phenomenon of global warming. In spite of that many developed countries are still reluctant to take bold steps to prevent further deterioration of world atmosphere. In midst of such deliberation, Japan has taken a very courageous step to control the green gas emission to reduce it by 25% within next 10 years. But to achieve this ambitious target to Green, I think we need a new criterion, in addition to the rationality of modern age. None other advancement is as rapid as computer and internet. They had penetrated so much, thus it has become almost impossible to think our life without them. And in future they will only grow wider and faster. We have already witnessed that, invention of new technologies has made a huge impact in our life style and the society itself. Though it may provide various advantages and convenience, at the same time many social problems have also arisen. To solve these problems, we need an additional criterion, which we call' '. We believe that this new criterion along with the existing modern age rationality will lead us to the ultimate success and we can achieve a world which is both technologically efficient and environment friendly. We call this as Post Modern Society that is Green and Symbiosis Society, which will be realized around year 2020. Present Modern Society is based on ubiquitous information environment, which can be considered as consisting of two computing aspects: Mobile Computing and Pervasive Computing. We then introduced advance ubiquitous computing where human and information systems will co-exist in a cooperative manner to the betterment of life and society, and to alleviate the predefined problems. We proposed a new 3rdaxis, comprised of symbiosis (nature and human) in addition to the existing ubiquitous computing to realize advance ubiquitous computing. By integrating these three axes, we created the Symbiotic Computing paradigm. From there a Symbiosis information system can be realized.

articleTitle: The thyroid disease analysis by a class of tissue P system
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: In this paper, we propose a new class of tissue P system. A new kind of membrane structure is constructed which is different with the traditional tissue P systems. New communication rules are described. Then a clustering algorithm is designed with implementation on this P system. Finally we apply the technique in the thyroid disease data set and obtain some classification result.

articleTitle: Histogram-based contrast enhancement for coronary artery angiography images
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: To solve the problem of the typical histogram equalization method used to enhance cardiac coronary artery angiography images, a novel method based on histogram equalization is proposed. Firstly, the Fuzzy C-Means clustering algorithm is adopted to realize the histogram's partition, and the control threshold is selected. Then histograms of sub-level are redefined by adopting local histogram modification to construct gray transfer function. Finally the enhancement result of sub-level is composed. The experimental results demonstrate that this image enhancement algorithm could significantly enhance detailed regions and produce little noise over-enhancement.

articleTitle: The impact of retelling e-stories on elementary students' attitude toward scientists and inventors
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: Facing the fact that science textbook describes content of scientific and technological inventions in exposition mode mostly, so that elementary pupils are difficult to comprehend. Story with a series of drawings to represent abstract scientific concepts can enhance learning, especially for elementary students. This study was carried out with an objective to discover whether females and males students significantly varied in their attitude after retelling local and global e-stories of science fair and inventions via comic. The study included twenty-four subjects comprising equal number of male and females of 10-11 years of age from a public school in a rural community. An analysis of covariance was used to correct for initial differences of prerequisite scores and attitudes towards science activities among treatment groups. While significant difference of Image of Scientists' Job (p <; 0.05) exists in local vs. global stories, no significant differences were observed between attitude of male and female participants. Practical implications and recommendations for future research on e-story approach are identified.

articleTitle: Attitude and requirement for Health Emergency Curriculum among medical students
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: Training of future physicians in public health issues has been recognized as an important component of medical education. This manuscript conducted a survey in the preventive medical students to get more definite information in developing a systematic curriculum and also the textbook for the Chinese medical students. Methods: A survey was disseminated to undergraduate medical students. 112 preventive medical students major in preventive medicine and public health management participated in our anonymous survey during 2010-2011. Frequencies, proportions, and odds ratios were calculated to assess requirement and awareness for health emergency curriculum in medical students. Results: Few students have ever participated in Health Emergency activities and seldom participated in any types of Health Emergency training previously. students showed the enthusiasm in welcoming a new course of Health Emergency, they supported the theory, Risk management, Field direction, Human Resource Construction, Surveillance, Materials Preparedness, Emergency Plan, Risk Communication, Evaluation of HE Event, Laboratory Management and HE response are important content for the new curriculum. more than 80% students thought it was very important or important to study by Case Discussion. And Group Discussion of Simulated Events and Simulation Exercises of HE Events were also widely welcomed. And one third of the students supported graduate the course by internship. Conclusions:. It is urgent to develop the HE curriculum in Chinese medical school and students are longing for it. And both the theoretical contents and internship content were very important in the new course.

articleTitle: Problems and thoughts on experiment teaching in medical microbiology??
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: Medical microbiology is an important part in microbiology teaching. However, there are some problems in our experiment teaching now, we endeavor to work out countermeasures and believe that the experiment teaching level and teaching quality will be improved after improve.

articleTitle: Flocking control of mobile autonomous agents via fuzzy logic approach
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: This paper investigates the problem of controlling multiple mobile agents to achieve flocking motion by using a fuzzy-logic-based potential function, while considering the influences of diversity of perception radius and initial velocities. A virtual leader is introduced to direct the group to track a desired path. Furthermore, the motion of the group is studied when the velocity damping and the mass of all agents are taken into account. By LaSalle's invariant principle, not only the system stability can be guaranteed, but the desired stable flocking motion can be also achieved. Numerical simulations are illustrated to demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Screening of NHase high-producing Rhodococcus ruber Strain TQD-58 by both parents inactivated protoplast fusion
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: A NHase high-producing strain TQD-58 from Rhodococcus ruber CGMCC3090 was closed and bred by both parents inactivated protoplast fusion technique. The two parental strains L<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">08-03</sub> and LUV<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">30-06</sub> were derived from a NHase-producing strain R. ruber CGMCC3090 by UV irradiation, UV and LiCl mutating respectively. The protoplasts of L<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">08-03</sub> and LUV<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">30-06</sub> were fully inactivated by heating at 55°C for 7 min and by UV irradiation (30W UV light and vertical distance 30cm) for 90 sec respectively. The highest fusion frequency (7.01×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-2</sup>) between L<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">08-03</sub> and LUV<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">30-06</sub> was obtained by fusion (90s) at the conditions of adding Polyethylene glycol (PEG, 40%). One hyper yielding fusant TQD-58 was screened and its NHase activity with 3-cyanopyridine as substrate was up to 4296.8 U/mL, which was increased by 20.79% and 10.71% compared with that of parental strains L<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">08-03</sub> and LUV<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">30-06</sub>, respectively. The genetic stability of TQD-58 was confirmed by successive subculture for 15 times.

articleTitle: Discovering secrets from texts: A self-organizing map perspective
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: Ordinary text documents such as text books, medical records, reports, research articles, Web pages, and mails dominate the information storage and dissemination in our daily life. However, it is difficult to process and extract useful information from them due to their unstructured nature. Different methodologies have been devised to discover various types of knowledge underlying massive amount of text documents. In this talk, I will first address the general problem of text mining which aims to discover interesting knowledge from unstructured text documents. The application of the self-organizing map (SOM) model, which is well reputed as a good tool for data clustering, in resolving this issue is then discussed. I will cover the basic schemes of SOM as well as some others with upgraded features. Different aspects of text mining using these schemes will also be shown with experimental results.

articleTitle: Application of biological information research on the prediction of echinococcus antigen epitope
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: Biological Information Research is widely used in development of Echinococcus Vaccine. From the genome sequencing to antigen epitope prediction, the database, compture and software connected together to provide the new idea for search and study the new gene and protein of Echinococcus, and its very useful for Antigen epitope prediction.

articleTitle: Investigation on the Influence of T-2 Toxin on the Ameloblasts in Rat's Incisor
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: T-2 toxin, which belongs to a group of mycotoxins synthesized by Fusarium fungi that are widely encountered as natural contaminants, induced enamel and ameloblasts damage in rats. SD rats were randomly divided into three groups and received gavages containing T-2 toxin in a dosage of 0, 100, and 200ng/g b.w., respectively. After 4 weeks, all rats were killed, serial sections along the long axis and HE method was used to stain ameloblast. In visual inspection, incisor color changed into faint yellow, part region showed light-proof and the tooth surface was a little rough in the poisoned groups. Under the Microscope, Tome's process of the ameloblasts disappeared and distorted and vacuolated ameloblasts existed in poisoned groups. The high-dose T-2 toxin group was more serious. This is the first report that T-2 toxin affects the cell morphology of ameloblasts and induces the appearance changes in tooth organ.

articleTitle: An evaluation of Distance Education Project for Party Members in Rural China
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: This study provides a glimpse into the ongoing Distance Education Project for Party Members in Rural China. It focuses on the status of DEPPMR among CCP members and the main factors attributed to the performance of DEPPMR. The results of this study could assist management and teaching staff to gather information about distance learners and their needs and desires, and assist management and teaching staff in thinking about what they are trying to do and what they hope to achieve as they implement programs and activities.

articleTitle: Research of access control strategy in EOC system based on VLAN
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: The concepts of the EOC and access control technology in EOC system were presented. The security issues for this environment were analyzed. The relevant requirements of access control in EOC system were researched. Depending on the special environment of EOC network and combining with the practical experience in the project development process, the method of EOC VLAN partition with double label based on business classification was proposed. The realization processes of this scheme were described in detail. At last, the advantage for the scheme was analyzed.

articleTitle: Analysis of lack of emotion on cooperative learning and countermeasure in network environment
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: The cooperative learning model in network environment has brought a broad space for education development; but the tendency of ignoring the emotional education in this environment has not been changed at all. This tendency is very adverse to the morality education. This paper presents the status and the analysis of lack of emotional education on cooperative learning, and put forward some methods of carrying out the cooperative learning and the countermeasures of increasing the intensity of emotional care in network environment.

articleTitle: Prolonging Time Synchronized Mesh Protocol network's lifetime by adjusting transmission range and routing graph
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: The Time Synchronized Mesh Protocol (TSMP) uses time synchronization, graph-routing and pre-scheduling of pair-wise communication while cycling through all available pre-divided channels to manage the whole network. With the collision-free network we study the energy-hole problem and discuss how to fix or improve this problem with mathematical analyses. When knowing where the reason lies, we propose an algorithm which can enable the nodes to choose their transmission range and next hop relay in order to adjust energy consumption of nodes in different position of the network. With this ability nodes that have less energy can reduce their work, so do the nodes in the region nearer the sink, thus the lifetime of the network can be prolonged. At last we evaluate this algorithm by means of the NS2 stimulation tools, and the simulation result shows that we finally get a network with relatively longer lifetime.

articleTitle: The importance of TL talk in an L2 class and some suggestions for its improvement
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Information Technologies in Medicine and Education
abstract: Teacher-learner talk is often thought to be less important than learner-learner talk in a second language class because it may diminish students' opportunities to practice their speaking. This paper, based on an analysis of some examples, tries to demonstrate how important teacher-learner talk can be in an L2 class and attempts to present some suggestions for improving it.
